Bekhorot 30b:11-16: Tanu rabbanan: habba lekabbel divre chaverut — tzarich lekabbel bifne shelosha chaverim, uvanav uvene beto enan tzerichin lekabbel bifne shelosha chaverim. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af banav uvene veto tzerichin lekabbel bifne shelosha chaverim, lefi sheeno dome chaver shekkibbel leven chaver shekkibbel.

Tanu rabbanan: habba lekabbel divre chaverut — tzarich lekabbel bifne shelosha chaverim, vaafillu talmid chacham tzarich lekabbel bifne shelosha chaverim. zaken veyoshev bishiva — eno tzarich lekabbel bifne shelosha chaverim, shekkevar kibbel alav mishshaa sheyyashav. abba shaul omer: af talmid chacham eno tzarich lekabbel bifne shelosha chaverim, velo od ella sheacherim mekabbelin lefanav.

Amar rabbi yochanan: bime beno shel rabbi chanina ben antignos nishnet mishna zo. rabbi yehuda verabbi yose istappak lehu milleta bitharot, shaddaru rabbanan legabbe beno shel rabbi chanina ben antignos, ezilu emaru leh: leayyen ba. ashkechu deka taen teharot, otev rabbanan middideh legabbayyhu, vekae ihu leayyone ba.
Ato amri leh lerabbi yehuda verabbi yose, amar lehu rabbi yehuda: aviv shel ze bizza talmide chachamim, af hu mevazze talmide chachamim!
Amar lo rabbi yose: kevod zaken yehe munnach bimkomo, ella miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash nahagu kohanim silsul beatzman, sheen mosrin et hatteharot lechol adam.
Tanu rabbanan: chaver shemmet — ishto uvanav uvene beto hare hen bechezkatan, ad sheyyechashedu. vechen chatzer shemmochrin bah techelet — hare hi bechezkatah, ad shettippasel.
Berakhot 43b:12-20: Tanu rabbanan: shishsha devarim genay lo letalmid chacham: al yetze keshehu mevussam lashshuk, veal yetze yechidi ballayla, veal yetze beminalim hametullaim, veal yesapper im ishsha bashshuk, veal yasev bachavura shel amme haaretz, veal yikkanes baacharona levet hammidrash. veyesh omrim: af lo yafsia pesia gassa, veal yehallech bekoma zekufa.

Al yetze keshehu mevussam lashshuk: amar rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: bemakom shechashudim al mishkav zachur. amar rav sheshet: la amaran ella bevigdo, aval begufo — zea meabbera leh. amar rav pappa: usearo kevigdo dame, veamri la kegufo dame.
Veal yetze yechidi ballayla: mishshum chashada. vela amaran ella dela kevia leh iddana, aval kevia leh iddana — midda yedia diliddaneh ka azel.

Veal yetze beminalim hametullaim: mesayyay leh lerabbi chiyyay bar abba. deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: genay hu letalmid chacham sheyyetze beminalim hametullaim. ini? veha rabbi chiyyay bar abba nafek! amar mar zutera bereh derav nachman: bitlay al gabbe telay. vela amaran ella befanta, aval begilda — let lan ba. uvefanta la amaran ella beorcha, aval beveta — let lan ba. vela amaran ella bimot hachamma, aval bimot haggeshamim — let lan ba.
Veal yesapper im ishsha bashshuk: amar rav chisda: vaafillu hi ishto. tanya name hachi: afillu hi ishto, vaafillu hi bitto, vaafillu hi achoto — lefi sheen hakkol bekiin bikrovotav.
Veal yasev bachavura shel amme haaretz: may tama? — dilma ate leimmeshoche batrayyhu.
Veal yikkanes baacharona levet hammidrash: mishshum dekaru leh "poshea".
Veyesh omrim, af lo yafsia pesia gassa: deamar mar, pesia gassa notelet echad mechamesh meot mimmeor enav shel adam. may takkanteh? lahdereh bekiddusha deve shimshe.
Veal yehallech bekoma zekufa: deamar mar hamehallech bekoma zekufa afillu arba ammot, keillu dochek ragle shechina, dichtiv: "melo chol haaretz kevodo".
Gittin 49b:3-11: Detanya, amar rabbi shimon: mippene ma amru hannizzakin shamin lahen beiddit? mippene haggazlanim umippene hachamsanin, kede sheyyomar adam: lama ani gozel velama ani chomes? lemachar bet din yordin linchasay venotlin sade naa shelli, vesomchim al ma shekkatuv battora: "metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem"; lefichach amru: hannizzakin – shamin lahen beiddit.
Mippene ma amru baal chov bevenonit? kede shello yire adam lachavero sade naa vedira naa, veyomar: ekpotz vealvennu, kede sheegbennu bechovi; lefichach amru: baal chov bevenonit.
Ella meatta, yehe bezibburit! im ken – atta noel delet bifne lovin.

Ketubbat ishsha – bezibburit, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: bevenonit. amar rabbi shimon: mippene ma amru ketubbat ishsha bezibburit? sheyyoter mimma shehaish rotze lissa, haishsha rotza linnase.
Davar acher: ishsha yotza lirtzonah veshello lirtzonah, vehaish eno motziah ella lirtzono.

May davar acher? vechi tema, ki hechi dechi mappek la ihu – takkinu la rabbanan ketubba minneh; ki nafka ihi name – litakkeni leh rabbanan ketubba minna? ta shema: ishsha yotza lirtzonah veshello lirtzonah, vehaish eno motzi ella lirtzono – efshar dimshahe la begitta.
Ketubbat ishsha bezibburit. amar mar zutera bereh derav nachman: la amaran ella miyyatme, aval minneh dideh – bevenonit.
Miyyatme?! may irya ketubbat ishsha? afillu kol mille name, deha tenan: en nifraim minnichse yetomim ella min hazzibburit! ella lav minneh?
Leolam miyyatme, uchetubbat ishsha itztericha leh – salka datach amena: mishshum chinna, akkilu rabbanan gabba; ka mashma lan.

Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:3-6:
Ellu devarim shel goyim asurin veissuran issur hanaa. hayyayin, vehachometz shel goyim shehaya mittechillato yayin, vecheres haderiyyani, veorot levuvin. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, bizman shehakkera shello agol, asur. mashuch, muttar. basar hannichnas laavoda zara, muttar. vehayyotze, asur, mippene shehu chezivche metim, divre rabbi akiva. haholchin lattarput, asur laset velatet immahem. vehabbain, muttarin: 
Nodot haggoyim vekankannehen veyayin shel yisrael kanus bahen, asurin, veissuran issur hanaa, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, en issuran issur hanaa. hachartzannim vehazzaggin shel goyim asurin, veissuran issur hanaa, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, lachin, asurin, yeveshin, muttarin. hammuryas ugevinot bet unyaki shel goyim asurin, veissuran issur hanaa, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, en issuran issur hanaa: 
Amar rabbi yehuda, shaal rabbi yishmael et rabbi yehoshua, keshehayu mehallechin badderech. amar lo, mippene ma asru gevinot haggoyim. amar lo, mippene shemmaamidin otah bekeva shel nevela. amar lo, vahalo kevat ola chamura mikkevat nevela, veamru, kohen sheddato yafa, sorfah chayya. velo hodu lo, aval amru, en nehenin velo moalin. chazar, amar lo, mippene shemmaamidin otah bekevat egle avoda zara. amar lo, im ken, lamma lo asaruha vahanaa. hissio ledavar acher, amar lo, yishmael achi, heach atta kore (Shir hashshirim 1), ki tovim dodecha miyyayin, o ki tovim dodayich. amar lo, ki tovim dodayich. amar lo, en haddavar ken, shehare chavero melammed alav, lereach shemanecha tovim: 
Ellu devarim shel goyim asurin veen issuran issur hanaa. chalav shechalavo goy veen yisrael roehu, vehappat, vehashshemen shellahen. rabbi uvet dino hittiru vashshemen. ushelakot, uchevashin sheddarkan latet letochan yayin vachometz, vetarit terufa, vetzir sheen bah daga chilbit shotetet bo, vehachillak, vekoret shel chiltit, umelach salkontit, hare ellu asurin veen issuran issur hanaa:
Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:7-3:4: Ellu muttarin baachila. chalav shechalavo goy veyisrael roehu. vehaddevash. vehaddavdaniyyot af al pi shemmenattefin, en bahem mishshum hechsher mashke. uchevashin sheen darkan latet letochan yayin vachometz. vetarit sheenah terufa. vetzir sheyyesh bah daga. veale shel chiltit. vezetim geluskaot hamegulgalin. rabbi yose omer, hashsheluchin, asurin. hachagavim habbaim min hasselula, asurin. min hahaftek, muttarin. vechen litruma:

Kol hatztzelamim asurim, mippene shehen neevadin paam achat bashshana, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, eno asur ella chol sheyyesh beyado makkel o tzippor o chaddur. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, kol sheyyesh beyado chol davar:
Hammotze shivre tzelamim, hare ellu muttarim. matza tavnit yad o tavnit regel, hare ellu asurim, mippene shekkayyotze vahen neevad:

Hammotze chelim vaalehem tzurat chamma, tzurat levana, tzurat derakon, yolichem leyam hammelach. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, sheal hamechubbadin, asurim. sheal hamevuzzin, muttarin. rabbi yose omer, shochek vezore laruach o mattil layyam. amru lo, af hu naase zevel, shenneemar (Devarim 13) velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem:

Shaal peroklos ben filosfos et rabban gamliel beakko, shehaya rochetz bammerchatz shel afroditi, amar lo, katuv betoratchem, velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem. mippene ma atta rochetz bammerchatz shel afroditi. amar lo, en meshivin bammerchatz. uchesheyyatza amar lo, ani lo vati vigvulah, hi vata vigvuli, en omrim, naase merchatz leafroditi noy, ella omrim, naase afroditi noy lammerchatz. davar acher, im notnin lecha mamon harebe, i atta nichnas laavoda zara shellecha arom uvaal keri umashtin befaneha, vezo omedet al pi habbiv vechol haam mashtinin lefaneha. lo neemar ella elohehem. et shennoheg bo mishshum eloah, asur. veet sheeno noheg bo mishshum eloah, muttar:
Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:5-8: Haggoyim haovdim et heharim veet haggevaot, hen muttarin uma shealehem asurim, shenneemar (Devarim 7) lo tachmod kesef vezahav alehem velakachta. rabbi yose haggelili omer, (sham 12) elohehem al heharim, velo heharim elohehem. elohehem al haggevaot, velo haggevaot elohehem. umippene ma ashera asura, mippene sheyyesh bah tefisat yad adam, vechol sheyyesh bah tefisat yede adam asur. amar rabbi akiva, ani ovin veadun lefanecha. kol makom sheatta motze har gavoah vegiva nissaa veetz raanan, da sheyyesh sham avoda zara:

Mi shehaya veto samuch laavoda zara venafal, asur livnoto. ketzad yaase, kones betoch shello arba ammot uvone. haya shello veshel avoda zara, niddon mechetza al mechetza. avanav etzav vaafaro, metammein kashsheretz, shenneemar (Devarim 7) shakketz teshakketzennu. rabbi akiva omer, kannidda, shenneemar (yeshaya 30) tizrem kemo dava, tze tomar lo, ma nidda metammea vemassa, af avoda zara metammea vemassa:

Shelosha vattim hen. bayit shebbanuy mittechilla laavoda zara, hare ze asur. siyyedo vechiyyero laavoda zara vechiddesh, notel ma shechiddesh. hichnis letocha avoda zara vehotziah, hare ze muttar. shalosh avanim hen. even shechatzavah mittechilla levimos, hare zo asura. siyyedah vechiyyerah leshem avoda zara vechiddesh, notel ma shechiddesh. heemid aleha avoda zara vesillekah, hare zo mutteret. shalosh asherot hen. ilan shennetao mittechilla leshem avoda zara, hare ze asur. giddeo ufisselo leshem avoda zara vehechelif, notel ma shehechelif. heemid tachteha avoda zara uvittelah, hare ze muttar. ezo hi ashera, kol sheyyesh tachteha avoda zara. rabbi shimon omer, kol sheovdin otah. umaase vetzaydan beilan shehayu ovdin oto, umatzu tachtav gal. amar lahen rabbi shimon, bidku et haggal hazze, uvedakuhu umatzu vo tzura. amar lahen, hoil velatztzura hen ovdin, nattir lahen et hailan:

Lo yeshev betzillah. veim yashav, tahor. velo yaavor tachteha. veim avar, tame. hayta gozelet et harabbim, veavar tachteha, tahor. vezorin tachteha yerakot bimot haggeshamim aval lo vimot hachamma. vehachazarin, lo vimot hachamma velo vimot haggeshamim. rabbi yose omer, af lo yerakot bimot haggeshamim, mippene shehannemiyya nosheret alehen vehova lahen lezavel:
Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:9-4:2: Natal mimmenna etzim, asurim bahanaa. hissik bahen et hattannur, im chadash, yuttatz. veim yashan, yutztzan. afa vo et happat, asura vahanaa. nitarva vaacherot, kullan asurot bahanaa. rabbi eliezer omer, yolich hanaa leyam hammelach. amru lo, en pidyon laavoda zara. natal hemenna charkor, asur bahanaa. arag bo et habbeged, habbeged asur bahanaa. nitarev baacherim vaacherim baacherim, kullan asurin bahanaa. rabbi eliezer omer, yolich hanaa leyam hammelach. amru lo, en pidyon laavoda zara:
Ketzad mevattelah. kirsem, vezerad, natal mimmenna makkel o sharvit, afillu ale, hare zo vetela. shefayah letzarkah, asura. shello letzarkah, mutteret:
Rabbi yishmael omer, shalosh avanim zo vetzad zo betzad markulis, asurot. ushetayim, muttarot. vachachamim omrim, shennirot immo, asurot. vesheen nirot immo, muttarot:
Matza verosho maot, kesut o chelim, hare ellu muttarin. parkile anavim vaatarot shel shibbolim veyenot ushemanim uselatot vechol davar shekkayyotze vo karev al gabbe hammizbeach, asur:
Mishnah Avodah Zarah 4:3-6:
Avoda zara shehaya lah ginna o merchatz, nehenin mehen shello vetova veen nehenin mehen betova. haya shellah veshel acherim, nehenin mehen ben betova uven shello vetova: 
Avoda zara shel nachri, asura miyyad. veshel yisrael, en asura ad shetteaved. nachri mevattel avoda zara shello veshel chavero, veyisrael eno mevattel avoda zara shel nachri. hamevattel avoda zara, bittel meshammesheha. bittel meshammesheha, meshammesheha muttarin vehi asura: 
Ketzad mevattelah, kata rosh aznah, rosh chatmah, rosh etzbaah, pechasah af al pi shello chisserah, bittelah. rakak befaneha, hishtin befaneha, gerarah, vezarak bah et hatztzoa, hare zo enah betela. mecharah o mishkenah, rabbi omer, bittel. vachachamim omrim, lo vittel: 
Avoda zara shehinnichuha ovdeha bishat shalom, mutteret. bishat milchama, asura. bimosyaot shel melachim, hare ellu muttarot, mippene shemmaamidin otam beshaa shehammelachim ovrim:
Mishnah Avodah Zarah 4:7-11:
Shaalu et hazzekenim beromi, im en retzono baavoda zara, lama eno mevattelah. amru lahen, illu ledavar sheen tzorech laolam bo hayu ovdin, haya mevattelo. hare hen ovdin lachamma velallevana velakkochavim velammazzalot. yeabbed olamo mippene hashshotim. amru lahen, im ken, yeabbed davar sheen tzorech laolam bo veyanniach davar shetztzorech haolam bo. amru lahen, af anu machazikin yede ovdehem shel ellu, sheomrim, tedu shehen elohot, shehare hen lo vatalu: 
Lokchin gat beuta min haggoy af al pi shehu notel beyado venoten lattappuach. veeno naase yen nesech, ad sheyyered labbor. yarad labbor, ma shebbabbor asur, vehashshear muttar: 
Dorchin im haggoy baggat, aval lo votzrin immo. yisrael shehu ose vetuma, lo dorchin velo votzrin immo, aval molichin immo chaviyyot laggat, umeviin immo min haggat. nachtom shehu ose vetuma, lo lashin velo orchin immo, aval molichin immo fat lappalter: 
Goy shennimtza omed betzad habbor shel yayin, im yesh lo alav milva, asur. en lo alav milva, muttar. nafal labbor veala, umedado vakkane, hittiz et hatztzira vakkane o shehaya metappeach al pi chavit meruttachat, bechol ellu haya maase, veamru yimmacher. verabbi shimon mattir. natal et hechavit uzerakah bachamato labbor, ze haya maase vehichshiru: 
Hametaher yeno shel nachri venotno virshuto bevayit happatuach lirshut harabbim, beir sheyyesh bah goyim veyisreelim, muttar. beir shekkullah goyim, asur, ad sheyyoshiv shomer. veen hashshomer tzarich lihyot yoshev umeshammer. af al pi shehu yotze venichnas, muttar. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer, kol reshut goyim achat hi:
Mishnah Tahorot 5:4-8:
Hashsheretz vehatztzefardea birshut harabbim, naga beachad mehem veasa tohorot veneechlu, taval, naga bashsheni veasa tohorot, hare ellu tehorot. im kayyamot harishonot, ellu vaellu teluyot. im lo taval bentayim, harishonot teluyot vehashsheniyyot yissarefu: 
Shene shevilin, echad tame veechad tahor, halach beachad mehen veasa tohorot, uva chavero vehalach bashsheni veasa tohorot, rabbi yehuda omer, im nishalu ze vifne atzmo veze vifne atzmo, tehorin. veim nishalu shenehem keechad, temeim. rabbi yose omer, ben kach uven kach, temeim: 
Shene chikkarim, echad tame veechad tahor, achal et achad mehem veasa tohorot uva chavero veachal et hashsheni veasa tohorot, rabbi yehuda omer, im nishalu ze vifne atzmo veze vifne atzmo, tehorin. veim nishalu shenehen keachat, temeim. rabbi yose omer, ben kach uven kach, temeim: 
Mi sheyyashav birshut harabbim uva echad vedaras al begadav, o sherakak venaga berukko, al rukko sorfim et hatteruma, veal begadav holchin achar harov. yashen birshut harabbim veamad, kelav temeim midras, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim metaharin. naga beechad ballayla, veen yadua im chay im met, uvashshachar amad umetzao met, rabbi meir metaher. vachachamim metammeim, shekkol hattumot kishat metziatan: 
Shota achat bair, o nachrit, o chutit, kol harukkim shebbair temein. mi sheddarsa ishsha al begadav, o sheyyashva immo bisfina, im makkirato shehu ochel batteruma, kelav tehorin. veim lav, yishalenna:
Mishnah Tahorot 5:9-6:3:
Ed omer nitma, vehu omer lo nitmeti, tahor. shenayim omrim nitmeta, vehu omer lo nitmeti, rabbi meir metamme. vachachamim omrim, hu neeman al yede atzmo. ed omer nitma, ushenayim omrim lo nitma, ben birshut hayyachid ben birshut harabbim, tahor. shenayim omrim nitma, veed omer lo nitma, ben birshut hayyachid ben birshut harabbim, tame. ed omer nitma veed omer lo nitma, ishsha omeret nitma veishsha omeret lo nitma, birshut hayyachid, tame. birshut harabbim, tahor: 
Makom shehaya reshut hayyachid venaasa reshut harabbim, chazar venaasa reshut hayyachid, keshehu reshut hayyachid, sefeko tame. keshehu reshut harabbim, sefeko tahor. hamesukkan birshut hayyachid vehotziuhu lirshut harabbim, vehecheziruhu lirshut hayyachid, keshehu virshut hayyachid, sefeko tame. keshehu virshut harabbim, sefeko tahor. rabbi shimon omer, reshut harabbim mafsaket: 
Arbaa sefekot rabbi yehoshua metamme vachachamim metaharin. ketzad. hattame omed vehattahor over, hattahor omed vehattame over, hattuma virshut hayyachid vetohora virshut harabbim, tohora virshut hayyachid vetuma virshut harabbim, safek naga safek lo naga, safek heehil safek lo heehil, safek hissit safek lo hissit, rabbi yehoshu metamme, vachachamim metaharin: 
Ilan shehu omed birshut harabbim vehattuma vetocho, ala lerosho, safek naga safek lo naga, sefeko tame. hichnis yado lechor sheyyesh bo tuma, safek naga safek lo naga, sefeko tame. chanut shehu tame ufatuach lirshut harabbim, safek nichnas safek lo nichnas, sefeko tahor. safek naga safek lo naga, sefeko tahor. shete chanuyyot, echad tame veechad tahor, nichnas leachad mehen, safek lattame nichnas safek lattahor nichnas, sefeko tame:
Mishnah Tahorot 6:4-7:
Kol sheatta yachol lerabbot sefekot usefek sefekot, birshut hayyachid, tame. birshut harabbim, tahor. ketzad, nichnas lemavoy vehattuma vechatzer, safek nichnas safek lo nichnas, tuma babbayit, safek nichnas safek lo nichnas, vaafillu nichnas, safek hayta sham safek lo hayta sham, vaafillu hayta sham, safek sheyyesh bah kashshiur safek sheen bah kashshiur, vaafillu sheyyesh bah, safek tuma safek tohora, vaafillu tuma, safek naga safek lo naga, sefeko tame. rabbi elazar omer, sefek bia, tahor. sefek magga tuma, tame: 
Nichnas levika bimot haggeshamim, vetuma besade felonit, veamar, halachti lammakom hallaz veeni yodea im nichnasti leoto hassade veim lo nichnasti, rabbi elazar metaher, vachachamim metammein: 
Sefek reshut hayyachid, tame, ad sheyyomar lo nagati. sefek reshut harabbim tahor, ad sheyyomar nagati. ezo hi reshut harabbim. shevile vet gilgul, vechen kayyotze vahen, reshut hayyachid leshabbat, ureshut harabbim lattuma. amar rabbi elazar, lo huzkeru shevile vet gilgul, ella shehem reshut hayyachid lechach ulechach. hashshevilim hamefullashim levorot uleshichim velimarot ulegittot, reshut hayyachid leshabbat ureshut harabbim lattuma: 
Habbika, bimot hachamma, reshut hayyachid leshabbat ureshut harabbim lattuma. uvimot haggeshamim, reshut hayyachid lechach ulechach:
Mishnah Tahorot 6:8-7:1:
Basilki, reshut hayyachid lashshabbat ureshut harabbim lattuma. rabbi yehuda omer, im omed hu vappetach hazze veroe et hannichnasin veet hayyotzin bappetach hallaz, reshut hayyachid lechach ulechach. veim lav, reshut hayyachid lashshabbat ureshut harabbim lattuma: 
Happaran, reshut hayyachid lashshabbat ureshut harabbim lattuma. vechen hatztzedadin. rabbi meir omer, hatztzedadin, reshut hayyachid lechach ulechach: 
Haistevanit, reshut hayyachid lashshabbat ureshut harabbim lattuma. chatzer sheharabbim nichnasim bazo veyotzim bazo, reshut hayyachid lashshabbat ureshut harabbim lattuma: 
Hakkaddar shehinniach et kederotav veyarad lishtot, happenimiyyot tehorot, vehachitzonot temeot. amar rabbi yose, bamme devarim amurim, bemuttarot. aval baagudot, hakkol tahor. hammoser maftecho leam haaretz, habbayit tahor, shello masar lo ella shemirat hammafteach:
Mishnah Tahorot 7:2-6:
Hammanniach am haaretz betoch beto er umetzao er, yashen umetzao yashen, er umetzao yashen, habbayit tahor, yashen umetzao er, habbayit tame, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, en tame ella ad mekom shehu yachol lifshot et yado veligga: 
Hammanniach ummanim betoch beto, habbayit tame, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, en tame ella ad mekom shehen yecholin lifshot et yadam veligga: 
Eshet chaver shehinnicha leeshet am haaretz tochenet betoch betah, paska harechayim, habbayit tame. lo faska harechayim, en tame ella ad mekom shehi yechola lifshot et yadah veligga. hayu shetayim, ben kach uven kach, habbayit tame, sheachat tochenet veachat meshammeshet, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, en tame ella ad mekom shehen yecholin lifshot et yadan veligga: 
Hammanniach am haaretz betoch beto leshamro, bizman shehu roe et hannichnasin veet hayyotzin, hoochalim vehammashkim uchele cheres happetuchim, temeim. aval hammishkavot vehammoshavot uchele cheres hammukkafin tzamid patil, tehorin. veim eno roe lo et hannichnasin velo et hayyotzin, afillu muval, afillu chafut, hakkol tame: 
Haggabbaim shennichnesu letoch habbayit, habbayit tame. im yesh immahen goy, neemanim lomar lo nichnasnu, aval en neemanim lomar nichnasnu aval lo naganu. haggannavim shennichnesu letoch habbayit, en tame ella mekom ragle haggannavim. uma hen metammein. hoochalim vehammashkim uchele cheres happetuchin. aval hammishkavot vehammoshavot uchele cheres hammukkafin tzamid patil, tehorim. im yesh immahen nachri o ishsha, hakkol tame:
Mishnah Tahorot 7:7-8:1:
Hammanniach et kelav bechallon shel odyarin, rabbi elazar ben azarya metaher. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyitten lo et hammafteach o chotam o ad sheyyaase siman. hammanniach et kelav miggat zo laggat habbaa, kelav tehorin. uveyisrael, ad sheyyomar belibbi haya leshamram: 
Mi shehaya tahor, vehissia et libbo milleechol, rabbi yehuda metaher, shedderech temein porshin mimmenu. vachachamim metammeim. hayu yadav tehorot vehissia et libbo milleechol, af al pi sheamar yodea ani shello nitmeu yaday, yadav temeot, shehayyadayim askaniyyot: 
Haishsha shennichnesa lehotzi fat leani, veyatzat umetzaattu omed betzad kikkarot shel teruma, vechen haishsha sheyyatzat umatzat et chavertah chota gechalim tachat kedera shel teruma, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim metaharin. amar rabbi elazar ben pila, vechi mippene ma rabbi akiva metamme vachachamim metaharin. mippene shehannashim gargeraniyyot hen, shehi chashuda legallot et hakkedera shel chavertah, leda ma hi mevashshelet: 
Haddar im am haaretz bechatzer, veshachach kelim bechatzer, afillu chaviyyot mukkafot tzamid patil, o tannur mukkaf tzamid patil, hare ellu temein. rabbi yehuda metaher betannur bizman shehu mukkaf tzamid patil. rabbi yose omer, af hattannur tame, ad sheyyaase lo mechitztza gavoah asara tefachim:
Mishnah Yoma 1:5-8:
Mesaruhu zikne vet din lezikne chehunna, veheeluhu laaliyyat bet avtinas, vehishbiuhu venifteru vehalchu lahem. veamru lo, ishi chohen gadol, anu sheluche vet din, veatta sheluchenu usheliach bet din, mashbiin anu alecha bemi sheshshikken shemo vabbayit hazze, shello teshanne davar mikkol ma sheamarnu lach. hu foresh uvoche, vehen porshin uvochin: 
Im haya chacham, doresh. veim lav, talmide chachamim dorshin lefanav. veim ragil likrot, kore. veim lav, korin lefanav. uvamme korin lefanav, beiyyov uveezra uvedivre hayyamim. zecharya ben kevutal omer, peamim harebe kariti lefanav bedaniyyel: 
Bikkesh lehitnamnem, pirche chehunna makkin lefanav beetzba tzereda, veomrim lo, ishi chohen gadol, amod vehafeg achat al haritzpa. umaasikin oto ad sheyyaggia zeman hashshechita: 
Bechol yom tormin et hammizbeach bikriat haggever o samuch lo, ben lefanav ben leacharav. beyom hakkippurim mechatzot, uvargalim meashmura harishona, velo hayta keriat haggever maggaat ad shehayta azara melea miyyisrael:
Mishnah Yoma 2:1-4:
Barishona kol mi sherotze litrom et hammizbeach, torem. uvizman shehen merubbin, ratzin veolin bakkevesh, vechol hakkodem et chavero vearba ammot zacha. veim hayu shenehem shavin, hamemunne omer lahem hatzebiu. uma hen motziin, achat o shetayim, veen motziin aguddal bammikdash: 
Maase shehayu shenehem shavin veratzin veolin bakkevesh, vedachaf echad mehen et chavero, venafal venishbera raglo. vechevan sherau vet din shebbain lide sakkana, hitkinu shello yehu tormin et hammizbeach ella vefayis. arbaa feyasot hayu sham, veze happayis harishon: 
Happayis hashsheni, mi shochet, mi zorek, umi medashshen mizbeach happenimi, umi medashshen et hammenora, umi maale evarim lakkevesh, harosh veharegel, ushete hayyadayim, haoketz veharegel, hechaze vehaggera, ushete haddefanot, vehakkeravayim, vehassolet, vehachavittin, vehayyayin. shelosha asar kohanim zachu vo. amar ben azzay lifne rabbi akiva mishshum rabbi yehoshua, derech hillucho haya karev: 
Happayis hashshelishi, chadashim lakketoret bou vehafisu. veharvii, chadashim im yeshanim, mi maale evarim min hakkevesh velammizbeach:
Mishnah Yoma 2:5-3:2:
Tamid karev betisha, baasara, beachad asar, bishnem asar, lo fachot velo yoter. ketzad. atzmo betisha. bechag, beyad echad tzelochit shel mayim, hare chan asara. ben haarbayim, beachad asar, hu atzmo betisha, ushenayim beyadam shene gezire etzim. uveshabbat beachad asar, hu atzmo betisha, ushenayim beyadam shene veziche levona shel lechem happanim. uveshabbat shebbetoch hechag, beyad echad tzelochit shel mayim: 
Ayil karev beachad asar, habbasar bachamishsha, hakkeravayim vehassolet vehayyayin bishnayim shenayim: 
Par karev beesrim vearbaa, harosh veharegel, harosh beechad, veharegel bishnayim. haoketz veharegel, haoketz bishnayim, veharegel bishnayim. hechaze vehaggera, hechaze beechad, vehaggera bishlosha. shete yadayim bishnayim. shete defannot bishnayim. hakkeravayim vehassolet vehayyayin bishlosha shelosha. bamme devarim amurim, bekarbenot tzibbur. aval bekarban yachid, im ratza lehakeriv, makriv. hefshetan venittuchan shel ellu vaellu shavin: 
Amar lahem hamemunne, tzeu ureu im higgia zeman hashshechita. im higgia, haroe omer, barkay. mattitya ben shemuel omer, heir pene chol hammizrach ad shebbechevron. vehu omer hen: 
Velama hutzrechu lechach, sheppaam achat ala meor hallevana vedimmu sheheir mizrach, veshachatu et hattamid, vehotziuhu levet hasserefa. horidu chohen gadol levet hattevila. ze hakkelal haya vammikdash, kol hammesech et raglav taun tevila, vechol hammattil mayim taun kiddush yadayim veraglayim:
Mishnah Yoma 3:11-4:3:
Veellu lignay, shel bet garmu lo ratzu lelammed al maase lechem happanim. shel bet avtinas lo ratzu lelammed al maase hakketoret. hugras ben levi haya yodea perek bashshir velo ratza lelammed. ben kamtzar lo ratza lelammed al maase hakketav. al harishonim neemar (Mishlei 10), zecher tzaddik livracha. veal ellu neemar (sham) veshem reshaim yirkav: 
Taraf bakkalpi veheela shene goralot. echad katuv alav lashshem veechad katuv alav laazazel. hassegan bimino verosh bet av missemolo. im shel shem ala vimino, hassegan omer lo, ishi chohen gadol, hagebeah yeminecha. veim shel shem ala vismolo, rosh bet av omer lo, ishi chohen gadol, haggebeah semolecha. netano al shene hasseirim veomer, laAdonai chattat. rabbi yishmael omer, lo haya tzarich lomar chattat, ella laAdonai. vehen onin acharav, baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed: 
Kashar lashon shel zehorit berosh sair hammishtalleach veheemido cheneged bet shillucho, velannishchat keneged bet shechitato. ba lo etzel paro sheniyya, vesomech shete yadav alav umitvadde. vechach haya omer, anna hashshem, aviti pashati chatati lefanecha ani uveti uvene aharon am kedoshecha. anna hashshem, kapper na laavonot velappeshaim velachataim, sheaviti vesheppashati veshechatati lefanecha ani uveti uvene aharon am kedoshecha, kakkatuv betorat moshe avdecha (Vayikra 16), ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem letaher etchem mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu. vehen onin acharav, baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed: 
Shechato vekibbel bammizrak et damo, unetano lemi shehu memares bo al haroved harvii shebbahechol, kede shello yikrosh. natal machta veala lerosh hammizbeach, ufinna gechalim elach veelach, vechote min hameukkalot happenimiyyot, veyarad vehinnichah al haroved harvii shebbaazara:
Mishnah Yoma 3:3-6:
En adam nichnas laazara laavoda, afillu tahor, ad sheyyitbol. chamesh tevilot vaasara kiddushin tovel kohen gadol umekaddesh bo vayyom, vechullan bakkodesh al bet happarva, chutz mizzo vilvad: 
Persu sadin shel butz beno leven haam. pashat, yarad vetaval, ala venistappeg. heviu lo vigde zahav, velavash vekiddesh yadav veraglav. heviu lo et hattamid. keratzo, umerak acher shechita al yado. kibbel et haddam uzerako. nichnas lehaketir ketoret shel shachar, ulehetiv et hannerot, ulehakriv et harosh veet haevarim veet hachavittin veet hayyayin: 
Ketoret shel shachar hayta kereva ben dam laevarim. shel ben haarbayim, ben evarim lannesachim. im haya chohen gadol zaken o istenis, mechammin lo chammin umetilin letoch hatztzonen, kede shettafug tzinnatan: 
Heviuhu levet happarva, uvakkodesh hayta. parsu sadin shel butz beno leven haam, kiddesh yadav veraglav ufashat. rabbi meir omer, pashat, kiddesh yadav veraglav. yarad vetaval, ala venistappeg. heviu lo vigde lavan, lavash vekiddesh yadav veraglav:
Mishnah Yoma 3:7-10:
Bashshachar haya lovesh pillusin shel shenem asar mane, uven haarbayim hindevin shel shemone meot zuz, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, bashshachar haya lovesh shel shemona asar mane, uven haarbayim shel shenem asar mane, hakkol sheloshim mane. ellu mishshel tzibbur. veim ratza lehosif, mosif mishshello: 
Ba lo etzel paro, ufaro haya omed ben haulam velammizbeach, rosho laddarom ufanav lammaarav, vehakkohen omed bammizrach ufanav lammaarav, vesomech shete yadav alav umitvadde. vechach haya omer, anna hashshem, aviti pashati chatati lefanecha ani uveti. anna hashshem, kapper na laavonot velappeshaim velachataim, sheaviti vesheppashati veshechatati lefanecha ani uveti, kakkatuv betorat moshe avdecha (Vayikra 16), ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem letaher etchem mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu. vehen onin acharav, baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed: 
Ba lo lemizrach haazara, litzfon hammizbeach, hassegan mimino verosh bet av missemolo. vesham shene seirim, vekalpi hayta sham uvah shene goralot. shel eshkeroa hayu, vaasaan ben gamla shel zahav, vehayu mazkirin oto leshavach: 
Ben katin asa shenem asar dad lakkiyyor, shello hayu lo ella shenayim. veaf hu asa mucheni lakkiyyor, shello yihyv memav nifsalin belina. munbaz hammelech haya ose chol yedot hakkelim shel yom hakkippurim shel zahav. hilni immo asta nivreshet shel zahav al pitcho shel hechol. veaf hi asta tavla shel zahav shepparashat sota chetuva aleha. nikanor naasu nissim ledaltotav, vehayu mazkirin oto leshavach:
Mishneh Torah, Prayer and the Priestly B: Batte kenesiyyot uvatte midrashot shecharvu bikdushshatan hen omdot shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 26 lo)</small> "vahashimmoti et mikdeshechem" af al pi shehen shommin bikdushshatan hen omdin. ucheshem shennohagin bahen kavod beyishshuvan kach nohagin bahen bechurbanam chutz mikkibbud veribbutz sheen mechabbedin otan veen marbitzin otan. alu bahen asavim tolshin otam umannichin otan bimkoman kede sheyyiru otan haam veteor rucham veyivnum:

En sotrin bet hakkeneset kede livnot acher bimkomo o bemakom acher. aval bonin acher veachar kach sotrin ze. shemma yeera lahem ones velo yivnu. afillu kotel echad mimmennu bone hechadash betzad hayyashan veachar kach soter hayyashan:

Bamme devarim amurim shello charvu yesodotav o shello natu ketalav lippol. aval im charvu yesodotav o shennatu ketalav lippol sotrin oto miyyad umatchilin livnot bimhera bayyom uvallayla shemma tidchok hashshaa veyishshaer charev:

Muttar laasot bet hakkeneset bet hammidrash. aval bet hammidrash asur laasoto bet hakkeneset. shekkedushshat bet hammidrash yetera al kedushshat bet hakkeneset umaalin bakkodesh velo moridin. vechen bene hair shemmachru bet hakkeneset yesh lahen likkach bedamav teva. machru teva yesh lahen likkach bedameha mitpachot o tik lesefer tora. machru mitpachot o tik lokchim bedamav chummashim. machru chummashin lokchin bedamav sefer tora. aval im machru sefer tora en lokchin bedamav ella sefer tora acher sheen sham kedushsha lemala mikkedushshat sefer tora. vechen bemotareha:

Vechen im gavu haam maot livnot bet hammidrash o levet hakkeneset o liknot teva o mitpachot vetik o sefer tora veratzu leshannot kol ma sheggavu. en meshannin otan ella mikkedushsha kalla likdushsha chamura mimmenna. aval im asu ma sheggavu laasot vehotiru meshannin hammotar lechol ma sheyyirtzu. vechol kele bet hakkeneset kevet hakkeneset. parochet sheal haaron shemmannichim bo hassefarim kemitpechot hassefarim. veim hitnu alehem hare hen kefi hattenay:

Bamme devarim amurim shemmuttar limkor bet hakkeneset, bevet hakkeneset shel kefarim shello asu oto ella al daat bene hakkefar levaddam sheyyihye lahem lehitpallel bo sheim ratzu kullam lemachro muttarin. aval bet hakkeneset shel kerakkin hoil veal daat kol anshe haolam naasa sheyyavo veyitpallel bo kol habba el hammedina naasa shel kol yisrael veen mochrin oto leolam:

Ketzad haam yoshvin bevatte kenesiyyot. hazzekenim yoshvin ufenehen kelappe haam vaachorehem kelappe hahechol. vechol haam yoshvin shura lifne shura ufene hashshura laachore hashshura shellefaneha ad sheyyihyu pene kol haam kelappe hakkodesh uchelappe hazzekenim uchelappe hatteva. uveet sheshsheliach tzibbur omed litfilla omed baaretz lifne hatteva ufanav lifne hakkodesh kishar haam:

Batte kenesiyyot uvatte midrashot nohagin bahen kavod umechabbedim otan umarbitzin otan. venohagin kol yisrael bisfarad uvammaarav beshinar uveeretz hatztzevi lehadelik ashashiyyot bevatte kenesiyyot ulehatztzia bekarkaan machtzelaot kede leshev alehem. uveare edom yoshvin bah al hakkisot:

Batte kenesiyyot uvatte midrashot en nohagin bahen kallut rosh kegon sechok vehittul vesicha betela. veen ochlin bahen veen shotin bahen veen neotin bahen veen metayyelin bahen veen nichnasin bahen bachamma mippene hachamma uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim. vachachamim vetalmidehem muttarin leechol velishtot bahen middochak:

Veen mechashshevin bahen cheshbonot ella im ken hayu cheshbonot shel mitzva kegon kuppa shel tzedaka ufidyon shevuyim vechayyotze bahen. veen maspidin bahen ella hesped shel rabbim kegon sheyyihye sham hesped gedole chachme otah hair shekkol haam mitkabbetzin uvain biglalan:

Haya levet hakkeneset o levet hammidrash shene petachin lo yaasennu kappandarya kede sheyyikkanes befetach ze veyetze bappetach shekkenegdo lekarev hadderech. sheasur likkanes bahen ella lidvar mitzva:

Mi shetztzarich likkanes levet hakkeneset likrot tinok o chavero yikkanes veyikra meat o yomar shemua veachar kach yikra chavero kede shello yikkanes bishvil chafatzav bilvad. veim eno yodea yomar letinok min hattinokot kera li happasuk sheatta kore bo. o yishhe meat bevet hakkeneset veachar kach yetze. shehayeshiva sham meiske hammitzvot hi shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 84 5)</small> "ashre yoshve vetecha" vegomer:

Mi shennichnas lehitpallel o likrot muttar lo latzet bappetach shekkenegdo kede lekarev et hadderech. umuttar laadam likkanes levet hakkeneset bemaklo beminalo uvaafundato uvaavak sheal raglav. veim haya tzarich larok yarok bevet hakkeneset:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 9:14-15:
Haose en hatztzeva hare ze toledet tzovea vechayyav. ketzad. kegon shennatan kankantom letoch me appetza shennaasa hakkol shachor. o shennatan istis letoch me karkom shennaasa hakkol yarok. vechen kol kayyotze baze. vechamma shiuro kede litzboa bo chut shearko arbaa tefachim: 
Hattove orech arbaa tefachim mikkol davar hannitve chayyav. echad hattove et hatztzemer o et happishtan o et hannotza o et hassear o et haggidin. vechen kol kayyotze bahen. haose et halleved hare ze toledet tove vechayyav. vehu sheyyelabbed davar sheefshar litvot mimmennu chut orech arbaa tefachim beovi benoni:
Niddah 23b:10-15: Amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba, amar rabbi yochanan: metzach, vehaggevinim, vehaenayim, vehallesatot, vegabbot hazzakan — ad sheyyehu kullam keechat. rava amar chassa: metzach, vehaggavin, vehaayin, vehalleset, vegabbat hazzakan — ad sheyyehu kullam keechat.
Vela feligi: ha keman deamar "kol tzurat", ha keman deamar "mitztzurat".
Metivi: tzurat panim sheamru — afillu partzuf echad min happartzufin, chutz min haozen. lememra demechad name saggi?
Amar abbaye: ki tanya hahi leakkev tanya, ucheman deamar kol tzurat, veibbaet ema: leolam keman deamar mitztzurat, umay "echad" — echad echad.
Amar rava: nivra beayin achat uveyarech echad — min hatztzad, immo temea; baemtza, immo tehora.
Amar rava: vishto nakuv — immo temea, vishto atum — immo tehora.
Pesachim 86b:6-12: Hakkalla hofechet et paneha vechulei. may tama? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: mippene shehi bosha.

Rav huna bereh derav natan ikkela leve rav nachman bar yitzchak. amaru leh: ma shemach? amar lehu: rav huna. amaru: nittev mar appureya! yetev, yehavu leh kasa, kabbeleh bechad zimna veshatyeh bitre zimne, vela ahdar appeh.
Amaru leh: may tama karet lecha rav huna? amar lehu baal hashshem ani. may tama ki amaru lach nittev appureya yetevt? amar lehu: kol ma sheyyomar lecha baal habbayit ase (chutz mitztze).

May tama ki yahavi lach kasa kabbelt bechad zimna? amar lehu: mesarvin lakkatan, veen mesarvin laggadol. may tama ishteteh bitre zimne? amar lehu: detanya, hashshote koso bevat achat hare ze gargeran, shenayim — derech eretz, shelosha — miggasse haruach. may tama la ahdart appach? amar lehu: "kalla hofechet paneha" tenan.

Rabbi yishmael berabbi yose ikkela leve rabbi shimon berabbi yose ben lakonya. yehavu leh kasa, kabbeleh bechad zimna veshatyeh bechad zimna. amri leh: la savar la mar hashshote koso bevat achat hare ze gargeran? amar lehu: la amri bechoscha katan veyencha matok ucheresi rechava.
Amar rav huna: bene chavura nichnasin bishlosha, veyotzin afillu beechad. amar rabba: vehu deayel beiddana dirgili lemeal, vehu dirgash behu dayyayla.
Amar ravina: venotnin sechar damim, vetzarich haacharon lehosif damim. velet hilcheta kevoteh.

Sanhedrin 89b:6-14: Hamevavter al divre navi, mena yada deianash? dihav leh ot. veha micha, dela yehav leh ot, veianash? hecha demuchezak shane.
Dei la tema hachi, avraham behar hammoriyya, hechi shema leh yitzchak? eliyyahu behar hakkarmel, hechi samchi aleh veavdi shechute chutz? ella hecha demuchezak shane.
"Vayhi achar haddevarim haelle vehaelohim nissa et avraham", achar may?

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose ben zimra: achar devarav shel satan, dichtiv "vayyigdal hayyeled vayyiggamal vegomer". amar satan lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, zaken ze chananto lemea shana peri veten, mikkol seuda sheasa lo haya lo tor echad o gozal echad lehakeriv lefanecha? amar lo: kelum asa ella bishvil beno? im ani omer lo "zevach et bincha lefanay" miyyad zovcho. miyyad "vehaelohim nissa et avraham".

"Vayyomer kach na et bincha". amar rabbi shimon bar abba: en "na" ella leshon bakkasha. mashal lemelech basar vadam sheamdu alav milchamot harebe, vehaya lo gibbor echad venitztzechan. leyamim amda alav milchama chazaka. amar lo: bevakkasha mimmecha, amod li bemilchama zo, shello yomru rishonot en bahem mammash. af hakkadosh baruch hu amar leavraham: nisseticha bechamma nisyonot veamadta bechullan. achshav amod li benissayon ze, shello yomru en mammash barishonim.
"Et bincha". shene banim yesh li. "et yechidcha". ze yachid leimmo veze yachid leimmo. "asher ahavta". tarvayyhu rachemna lehu. "et yitzchak". vechol kach lamma? kede shello tittaref dato alav.
Kedamo satan ladderech. amar lo: "hanissa davar elecha tile... hinne yissarta rabbim veyadayim rafot techazzek. koshel yekimun millecha... ki atta tavo elecha vattele". amar lo: "ani betummi elech".

Amar lo: "halo yiratcha kislatecha". amar lo: "zechor na mi hu naki avad". kevan dachaza dela ka shamay leh, amar leh: "veelay davar yegunnav". kach shamati meachore happargod: "hasse leola" veen yitzchak leola. amar lo: kach onsho shel badday, sheafillu amar emet en shomin lo.

Rabbi levi amar: achar devarav shel yishmael leyitzchak. amar lo yishmael leyitzchak: ani gadol mimmecha bemitzvot, sheatta malta ben shemonat yamim, vaani ben shelosh esre shana. amar lo: uveever echad atta megare bi? im omer li hakkadosh baruch hu "zevach atzmecha lefanay", ani zoveach. miyyad: "vehaelohim nissa et avraham".
Zohar, Addenda, Volume III 11:141-12:163: Amar rabbi elazar, kammah yeot veshappir hay. zakkaa orcha dilan. vechamma milin illain kaddishin ravvavchna lon vechamena. hahu yuday hava tamman lekamayyhu. amar lon, rabbanan, kol milin illen, kama tavan. umilin illain kaddishin ninhu. may dichtiv batreh, yimtzaehu beeretz midbar uvetohu yelel yeshimon vegomer.

Amru leh, i yadat beh milla, ema. deha ukemu beavraham, deashkach leh kudesha berich hu beara defalche avoda zara vela havu yade bimhemnuta dekudesha berich hu. ella kullehu havu taan batar avoda zara, vekam avraham ufarach benayyhu anafa chada shelim, kodam mare dealma. vashkach leh tamman.

Ma avad kudesha berich hu, natal leh lehahu anfa, veaakar leh mittamman vashre leh, vishtaddel. veshatal leh beara achara. dichtiv (Bereshit 12) lech lecha meartzecha vegomer. veavid minneh amma kaddisha. veda hi metzia deashkach kudesha berich hu bealma beara, dela mehemne beh vekudesha berich hu vela yade man ihu.

Amar hahu yuday shappir hu, veyeot milla da. aval it leshaala, i avraham hava diyyukena deitzterich. vetu deha kera, la ochach al avraham kelal vela idkar leavraham kelal, vela leyitzchak, ella leyaakov bilchodoy. dichtiv ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov vegomer, uvatreh ketiv, yimtzaehu vegomer.

Amar rabbi elazar, im kol ze lo kashya hacha. deha avraham ashkechan denafak miggo palche avoda zara. vehacha af al gav deyaakov adkar, hu al avraham. velet pirucha kelal bemilla da. aval i yadat milla o chiddosha ima:

Patach veamar hahu yuday (Bereshit 1:2) vehaaretz hayta tohu vavohu vegomer. man aretz, hahi deishtemoda ilaa vetattaa. hayta tohu, may tohu. da kav yarok deakif kol alma vikre kav tohu. dichtiv (yeshaya 31) vnata aleh kav tohu vavne bohu. bohu, kema detanenan, avanin mefulamot demishtakan go tehome uminhon nafke mayin.

Hasheta it leminda. tohu deihu kav yarok, man hava (hu) kav yarok, ella ashkechan besifra deasya dekartinaa veyodan dekesare shemeh, vekaran shemeh asya kartinaa. begin dehu rav al kol asyayn veyakkira bechachmata. vehachi amar (imre) belashon parsi lebar nash yakkira. vehu amar, vehaaretz hayta tohu, may tohu, ihi kav yarok deaschar alma. uman ihu kelippa deegoza veda ihu kelippa dilvar deihu yarok.

Lego minneh bohu, veinun avanin mefulamot deminnehon nafke mayin. min tohu itmashchan or uvasar. min bohu itmeshachu garme lego minneh. vechoshech, da meshichu deitmeshach minneh amma deesav. vei tema man tohu. hare (hachi) hu vday, deha choshech minneh talyyay. ella inun avanin mefulamot, alu beemtzaita deminneh itmashchan garme kema deittemar. vechoshech meshichu dakik, deminneh itmeshach esav.

Veruach elohim da mocha deegoza, demittamman itmeshach yaakov shelema, kegavvna deegoza da. raza dichtiv (yechezkel 1:4) vehinne ruach seara baa min hatztzafon, lokovleh detohu. lego minneh, anan gadol, lekobbeleh debohu. lego minneh, veesh mitlakkachat, lekobbeleh dechoshech. lego minneh, vnoga lo saviv, lekobbeleh deruach elohim.

Umitocha keen hachashmal, lego mikkolla. lekobbeleh merachefet al pene hammayim. da rucha deima ilaa, deka merachefet al kolla. veyaakov shelema ihu, veda mocha deegoza vekudesha berich hu yimtzaehu beeretz midbar, vday. levatar avad kudesha berich hu dechol inun kelippin yehon kulehon mishtabedan leh.

Ad hacha hava ketiv behahu sifra (deasya) dekartinaa asya. levatar hava rashim behay kera, kol netura deitzterich asya, chakkim lemebad lemera deshachiv beve mare asire demalka, lemiflach lemare alma.

Dechad azil asya chakkim legabbeh, yimtzaehu beeretz midbar uvetohu yelel yeshimon. marin desharyayn aleh ashkach leh baasire demalka. i tema hoil vekudesha berich hu yifkod letafsha leh dela yishtaddal bar nash abbatreh, lav hachi. deha david amar (Tehillim 41:2) ashre maskil el dal vegomer vedal hu deshachiv beve mare. vei asya chakkim hu, kudesha berich hu yahav leh birchaan lehahu deyishtaddal beh.

Vehahu asya yimtzaehu beeretz midbar, beve mare shachiv. uvetohu yelel yeshimon, deinun marin dachakin leh. may itzterich leh lemebad yesovevenhu, yesovev sibbuv veyete ilot begin deyimna minneh inun millin denazkin leh, yakiz leh, veyippuk minneh dama bisha. yevonnehu, yistakkel veyavin, hahu mara mimma havi. veyistakkel begin dela yitrabbe aloy veyimach leh. levatar yitzrenhu keishon eno, begin diyhe natir kedka yeot beinun mashkin, beinun asvavta deitzterichu leh. vela yite minayyhu, deilmale yite afillu bemilla chada, kudesha berich hu chashiv al asya keilu shafich dama vekatleh.

Begin dekudesha berich hu bae deaf al gav dehahu bar nash ihu be asire demalka, deyishtaddal bar nash aleh viysayyea leh leappaka leh mibbe asire. vehava amar hachi, kudesha berich hu dan dini bene alma leella, hen lamut, hen lesharushe, hen laakor, hen laanosh nichsin. man deitchaze laanosh nichsin, nafil beve mare vela yitse, ad deavar kol ma deitgazar aleh. kevan deitanash bemamoneh, veyahiv leh kol ma deitgazar aleh, itse venafak mibbe asire. veal da itzterich leishtaddela aleh, deyitten onasha veyippuk.

Man deitchaze lesharushe, yittefsun leh, veyahave leh beve asire. ad deyishtaresh mikkola. ulezimnin deyishtaresh mishayyfoy, o mechad minayyhu, ulevatar yippekun leh mibbe asire. man deitchaze lamut, hachi hu, deillu yitten kol kofra vechol mamona dealma la yishteziv.

Veal da itzterich leasyyay chakkim leishtaddela aleh, i yachil lemehav leh asvavta min gufa, yeot. vei lav, yitten leh asvata lenishmateh vyishtedal al asvavta denishmata. veda hu asya dekudesha berich hu yishtaddal aleh behay alma uvealma deate.

Amar rabbi elazar, ad hasheta la shamana measyyay da umisifra da, bar mozimna chada. deamar li tayyaya chada deshama leavoy, deasya chad hava veyomoy. dechad hava mistakkel bevar nash kad ihu beve mare, hava amar, da chay veda mit. vahavu amrin aleh, (dehu hava zakkaa), dachil chattaa. vechol man dela yachil lemidbak 124 lemizban] ma deitzterich, ihu hava kane leh veyahiv moddileh. vahavu amrin, delet chakkim bealma kegine. uvitzloteh hava avid yattir mimma dehava avid bidoy, vechaddome lan, da hava hahu asya.

Amar hahu tayyaya, vadday sifra dileh beyadi ihu, deka yeritna meavi abba. vechol milloy dehahu sifra, kullehu ityyaysdan al razin deorayyta verazin setimin ashkachna beh. umilin deasvavta deihu amar dela yeot lemifal lon, bar man deihu dachil chattaa.

Veinun mimma dehava avid bilam dehava lachish al mera, vehu amar befumeh, veittese miyad. vechullehu barir lon behahu sifra. veamar, da asur veda muttar leman dedachil chattaa, begin demarin saggiin amar, detalyay asvavta dilhon bilchishu depuma, vinun misitra denachash, uminhon misitra dekesem. vechol inun deasur lomar befuma veasur lemebad veovada, hava amar. ad deashkachna al marin yedian deitzterich lomar kach, ulenaduye beniduy uveshamatta al hahu mera, veihu tavvha saggi legabban.

Chadde rabbi elazar vechaddu chavrayyay. amar ribbi elazar i hay sifra hava legabban, nechme may ihu. amar, ana emsar bimsira al menat leachavaa (leachazaa) levotzina kaddisha. vetanenan, amar ribbi elazar, hahu sifra hava bidi teresar yarche, vashkachna beh nehorin illain. kad matena leinun razin dahavu mibbilam tavavhna.

Yoma chad lachishna beatar chad, vahavu atvavn salkan vnachtan. ad dechaminan bechelma veamar li, ma lach lemeal bitchuma delav dilach. ittearna veavish kammay al razin setimin dahavu tamman, shadarna lehahu yuday veyahivna leh sifra.

Ubberazin debilam ashkachna meinun shemahan demalachim deshadar leh balak, vela havu mitsadran al tikunayyhu. aval kama zine asvavta ashkachna beh deka mittakne al tikkune orayyta verazin setimin dileh. vechamena deinun bechasiduta utzelotin lekudesha berich hu. vei tema dehava avid asvavta bippesuke deorayyta, chas veshalom. ella hava amar razin deorayyta, veal hahu raza appik razin deasvavta, dela chamena kehahu goona lealmin. amena, berich rachamana deachkim livne nasha bechachmata dilella.

Umeynun millin debilam nasivna. vechamena behu, dela hava bealma chakkim becharshin kegineh. amena, berich rachamana devatil mealma charshin dela yitun bene nasha mibbatar dachalta dekudesha berich hu. ad kan:
Zohar, Pinchas 2: Rabbi shimon amar hay kera raza dechachmeta it beh. hayyoshevet bagannim, da keneset yisrael, deihi begaluta im yisrael, veazla immehon beaktayyhu. chaverim makshivim lekolech, mashiryayn illain. kullehu tzayytin lekolech, lekol tushebachtech begaluta. hashemiini, kema deat amer (Shir hashshirim 2:14) hareini et marayich hashemiini et kolech. hashemiini, kala deinnun chavrayyay demishtaddele beorayyta deha let tushebachta kammay, keinnun demishtaddele beorayyta.

Amar rabbi shimon, kivyachol, kol innun dezakkan leishtaddela beorayyta, umikkad palig lelya, veatyayn bematronita kad nahir yemama, lekabbela anpe malka, atkif veachasin bishchinta. velo od, ella desharya beh chut shel chesed, kema deokimna.

Ta chaze, kol man dezache leittakaf bishchinta, yistemar garmohi meinnun millin daachidan lokovlah. kegon man. innun dela meshakkere beat kadisha, kegon bat el nechar. vechol man denatir garmeh, kivyachol keneset yisrael achida beh, venatra leh, vehi akdimat leh shelam. vekol shekken i zache vekkane lehay.

Veamar rabbi shimon, itchazyayn yisrael leishtetzaa behahu shaata, bar deakdim pinchas lehay ovada, veshachich rugeza. hada hu dichtiv, pinchas ben elazar ben aharon hakkohen heshiv vegomer. davar acher, pinchas ben elazar vegomer. amar rabbi shimon, ben ben tere zimne, leashlema ovada (nusach acher ovada) ka ate.

Amar ribbi shimon, hay bar nash denatil gilgula denishmeta, vela zache deyittakkan beh, keillu meshakker bekusheta demalka. vaana karenna aleh hay kera (Vayikra Adonai:22) o matza aveda vechichesh bah venishba al shaker. vechichesh bah, tav leh dela ivre.
Zohar, Pinchas 56:345-57:350: Amar rabbi shimon, man defatach pitcha yemma. amar ribbi elazar, tanenan, kol man deamar tehilla ledavid bechol yom telat zimnin, ihu bar alma deate. veha ittemar taama. i begin parnasa umezona dechol almin, teren zimnin innun bechol yoma betzafra uvefanyay, dichtiv, (Shemot 15) betet Adonai lachem baerev basar vegomer, amay telat zimnin bechol yoma. ella teren limzona divne inshe udechol alma. vechad lemehav tukepa lehahu atar diftichu yedoy.

Uteren mezonin illen meshanyayn da min da, vechullehu telat mezone ketive hacha, (Tehillim 145:15) veatta noten lahem et achlam veitto, da mezona daatire, deyahiv mechla saggi beitto, ha chad. teren, dichtiv umasbia lechol chay ratzon, da mezona demiskene, deinnun sevein meratzon, vela miggo mechla saggi. telat dichtiv poteach et yadecha, da tukepa lehahu atar, veviftichu deyadoy, nafka ratzon vesava lecholla.

Tu hachi olifna, dela ihu ella tere zimne, begin mezona ufarnasa bechol yoma. deillen chiyyuva al bar nash. vei amar yattir, lav begin chova ihu, ella begin shevacha go tushebchan dizmirot dedavid malka. (sefer acher denafik yedoy dekudesha berich hu uvarich leshiva mertzon veal da lav chiyyuva hu ella tere zimne beyoma ushevacha ihu lekudesha berich hu latet lo zemirot dedavid malka) may tama. begin defarnasa la chaze lemishal ella batar tzelota ufarnasa demareh. malka yechul bekadmita ulevatar yechlun avdoy.

Hada hu dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim Adonai:1) bati leganni achoti challa achalti yari im divshi shatiti yeni im chalavi, levatar ichlu reim. achalti yari, da tzelota dimyushav. im divshi da keriat shema. achalti yari da tzelota dimyushav, hahu yaar levanon, yotzer or (sefer acher meshartim) vehaofannim vechayyot hakkodesh, (kullam kedoshim) kol hane ikrun yaar ilanin unetzivin deveh. im divshi da keriat shema, deihu metiku decholla, bechamma tzufin umetikin.

Shatiti yeni, da tzelota, dimumad, metivu (sefer acher meshichu) deyena illaa deitnetar. veda beshalosh berachot rishonot. im chalavi, illen innun shalosh berachot acharonot, veitkelilan illen beillen. ad kaon mechla demalka. levatar deachal malka, ichlu reim leella, shetu veshichru dodim letatta.

Veal da let chiyyuva dimzona ella levatar tzelota. bitzlota demincha (beerev) kodem tzelota may tama. begin dead la ishtechach dina kashya, beod deanpin demalka nehirin, yemma tehilla ledavid, behay siddura dimzona. dilvatar dedina sharya vetale al alma, lav shaata ihu. ata ribbi pinchas uneshakeh.
Zohar, Pinchas 6: Ribbi yesa patach, (Tehillim 137:1) al naharot bavel sham yashavnu gam bachinu bezachrenu et tziyyon. et yerushalam mibbae leh, kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 137:1) im eshkachech yerushala 40 tishkach yemini, may bezachrenu et tziyyon. lebar nash dehava leh hechala yakira, yaa veshappira, atu listin veokidu leh. tzaara deman hu, lav demareh dehechala. uf hacha shechinta begaluta sharya, tzaara deman hu, lav detzaddik. veazla ha kema deukemuha, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 57:1) hatztzaddik avad, avad mammash. uf hacha bezachrenu et tziyyon, bezachrenu hahu tzaara dileh al ziuugaha, tzaara dileh hu.

Amar ribbi yesa, man deokir shema demareh behay, venatir hay, zacha deyokir leh mareh al kolla. menalan. miyyosef. dichtiv, (Bereshit 41:43) vayyarkev oto bemirkevet hammishne asher lo, uchetiv venaton oto al kol eretz mitzrayim velo od, ella kad avru yisrael yat yamma, arona deyosef al bego bekadmita, vela havo mayya kayymin al kiumayyhu kammeh, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 114:3) hayyam raa vayyanos. may vayyanos. ella raa hahu dichtiv beh (Bereshit 39:12) vayyanas vayyetze hachutza.

Ta chaze, zache likara bechayyyoy vezache likara bemitateh. bechayav amay. begin hahu zeman dela baa leitdabbeka bah, dichtiv, (Bereshit 39:10) vaymaen vayyomer el eshet adonav. uchetiv velo shama eleha lishkav etzlah lihyot immah. begin kach zacha behay alma. kevan dichtiv vattitpesehu bevigdo, uchetiv vayanas vayyetze hachutza, zache levatar deal lego parochta illaa, vehachi itchaze leh, dideh natal behay alma, vedideh natal bealma achara.

Pinchas zache behay alma, vezacha bealma deate, vezacha lekayyeyma yatir mikkol innun denafku mimmitzrayim, vezacha lechahana illaa, hu vechol benoy abbatreh. vei tema dela (nusach acher deha) zacha lechahana ad la aved ovada da. in (sefer acher lo). deha innun deamre (dela) dezacha kodem. lav hachi ella bemay okimna tachat asher kinne lelohav, demashma divgin ovada da ravavch kehunata, ma dela hava kodem.

Ta chaze, kol kohen dekatil nefesh, pasil leh kehunateh lealmin. deha vadday pasil hahu darga dileh legabbeh. ufinchas min dina pasil lechahana hava, uvegin dekanne leh lekudesha berich hu, itzterich leyachasa leh kehunat almin, leh, velivnoy abbatreh, ledare darin. amar ribbi yitzchak, ta chaze, rashim hu pinchas leella, verashim hu letatta, ad la yippuk lealma deha im innun denafku mimmitzrayim itmene.

Ribbi elazar veribbi yose veribbi chiyyay, havo azle bemadbera, amar ribbi yose, ha dichtiv befinchas hinni noten lo et beriti shalom. shalom mimmalach hammavt, dela shallit beh lealmin, vela itdan bedinoy. vei tema dela mit. vadday la mit kishar bene alma, veorich yomin al kol bene dara, begin divhay berit illaa achid, vechad istellak mealma, betiuveta illaa uvidvikuteh shappira istallak mishshear bene alma.
Zohar, Pinchas 8: Amar ribbi chiyyay leribbi elazar, illen yomin, merosh hashshana ad yoma batraa dechag, baena lemekam alayyhu. amar ribbi elazar, ha ittemar vechavrayyay itaru behu. amar ribbi chiyyay, vadday hachi hu, aval ana shemana levutzina kadisha illaa milla behu. amar leh, ema hahu milla. amar leh ad la kaimna beh. amar ribbi elazar, af al gav dechavrayyay okmu milla, veshappir hu, aval siddura dehane yome, raza dechachmeta hu, ben mechatztzede chakla.

Ta chaze, ha ittemar siddura deyichuda kolla bechad hech havi. veha ittemar. patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 52:10) chasaf Adonai et zeroa kadsho, da deroa chada, deveh talya yeshua, deveh talya nukema, deveh talya purekana. velamma, lemekam lah lechneset yisrael meafra, ulekabbela lah legabbeh, leizdavvevga kachada. vechad hay itar lekabbelah, kama dechilu sharya bealma, ad deyanach hahu deroa techot reshaha leitchabbera. kema deat amar, (Shir hashshirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi vegomer, ucheden nayycha dina, umechapper chovin.

Levatar ate yemina lechabbeka, keden chedvavta sharyay bealma, vechol anpin nehirin. levatar izdavvevgat begufa, ucheden kolla ikre echad, bela piruda, keden hu shelimu decholla, vechedvavta decholla, veachidu vday, ma dela ishtechach hachi bishar zimne.

Kegavvna dehay, siddura dehane yomin, merosh hashshana ad yoma batraa dechag. berosh hashshana, itar deroa dismala, lekabbela lah lematronita, ucheden kol alma bidchilu bedina, uvae hahu zimna betiyyuveta shelim, leishtachcha alma kamme kudesha berich hu. levatar atiat matronita, uvayayn bene hechala betisha leyarcha, lemebad chedvavta, ulemitbal benahara, ledacha garmayyhu bezivuga dematronita, beyoma achara, hu ziuuga dilah leshavvava semala techot reshaha, (nusach acher resha demalka) kema deat amar semolo tachat leroshi.

Ucheden yisrael betaanita al chovayyhu, umechappera lehu. deha imma illaa anhirat anpaha lematronita beziuugaha, umitkapperin kol bene hechala. kevan dismala mekabbelah lah behay yoma, deresha dematronita sharyay al semala.

Beyoma kadmaa dechag, yitar yemina lekabbelah, begin lechabbeka ucheden kol chedvav vechol anpin nehirin, vechedvavta demayim tzelilan, lenassecha al madbecha. uvayayn bene nasha lemechede bechol zinin dechedva, deha yemina garim. bechol atar deshari yemina, chedvavta itzterich becholla, keden chedvavta hi leishtashea.

Levatar beyoma teminaa, chedvavta deorayyta hu, deha keden ziuuga degufa, hu ziuuga decholla, lemehevi kolla chad, veda hu shelimu decholla, veda yoma deyisrael ihu vadday, veadva didhu bilchodayyhu, delet beh chulaka leachara. zakkain innun yisrael bealma den, uvealma deate, alayyhu ketiv (Devarim 14:2) ki am kadosh atta laAdonai elohecha vegomer.
Zohar, Vayakhel 14: Hay nekuda tattaa kad salleka veitchazit, veitkashshitat. (sefer acher hay nekuda tattaa kad salleka leitattera baavahan) keden kol chedva ishtechach leella vetatta, vealmin kullehu bechedva. uvehay lelya, hay nekuda itpashat nehoraa, ufaris gadpoy al alma, vechol shiltonin acharanin mitabberan, unetiru ishtechach al alma.

Ucheden ittosaf ruach nishmeta beyisrael, al kol chad vechad, uvehahi nishmeta yetera, nashyayn kol itzba vechemata, vela ishtechach bar chedva, leella vetatta. hahu rucha denachit veittosaf bivne alma, kad nachit, itsache bevusemin deginta deeden, venachit veshara al amma kaddisha, zakkain innun, kad hay rucha itar.

Behahi shaata dehahu rucha nachit nachtin immah lego ginta deeden, shittin retichin, mitatterin leshit sitrin. vechad mate leginta deeden, keden kol innun ruchin venishmatin deginta deeden, kullehu (mitare lehahu mitattere (nusach acher behahu)) rucha. keruze kare veamar, zakkain attun yisrael, amma kaddisha, diruta demarichon ittear legabbayychu.

Raza derazin leyade chachmeta, zakkain innun kad hay rucha itar. hay rucha ihu itpashshetuta dehay nekuda, venafka minnah, veitpashsheta bealma, vehahu have raza deshabbat, deshara letatta, veal da ketiv beh shemira, (Shemot 31:16) veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat, veha ukemuha, shabbat la ketiv, ella et hashshabbat, leasgaa hahu rucha deshare al kolla, veitzterich lenatra leh, hoil vekayyeyma immeh devar nash, veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 56:6) kol shomer shabbat mechallelo.

Behay raza it raza achara. hay rucha, ithani behay yoma, mehanaotan deyisrael, umeinnuga dilhon, uvegin da, bae lemehav leh innuga, bemechla uvemishteya, telat zimnin, bitlat seudatin, ditlat darge mehemnuta, kema deukemuha. vehay natil chedva veinnuga, beinnun seudate deyisrael. zakkaa chulakeh, man deahane leh, umeaneg leh, behay yoma.

Hay rucha, ithane kol shita yomin, merucha illaa deattika dechol attikin. uveyoma deshabbeta, kevan denachit, veitsache beginta deeden belelya, itannag (Rosh Chodesh amud alef, 98 amud bet) meinnuga degufa, bisudate dimhemnuta, veitattar (nusach acher veitannag) hay rucha meella vetatta, veitrave bechol sitrin, beitra dilella vetatta.

Vehoil vekayyeyma immeh devar nash, itzterich leh lenatra leh. veal da ketiv veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat. shabbat, da hu hahi nekuda tattaa. et hashshabbat, da hu hay rucha, itpashshetuta dehahi nekuda. hahu itpashshetuta, kad ittosaf kiddushan uvirkan milleella, al hahi nekuda, itnehir kolla, veitavid rucha nehira bechol sitrin, itpelag leella venahir. veitpelag letatta venahir. veda hu dichtiv beni uven beni yisrael chulak achasana it lan kachada.

Chulaka dilella, itattar behay yoma, meinnuga illaa kaddisha, veithane mizziva illaa deattika dechol attikin. chulaka tattaa, itattar behay yoma, meinnuga diltatta, deithane behane seudate. veal da, bae leannega leh, bemechla uvemishteya bilvushe yekar, uvechedva decholla.

Vechad mitattera hay chulaka letatta, veitnetir kema deitzterich, salleka leella, veitchabbera behahu chulaka achara. vehay nekuda natil kolla meella vetatta, veitkelila mikkol sitrin. uvegin demitattera beshabbat, meella umittatta, kol shear yomin yahiv chela lecholla, veityeyhiv leh shuletanu meella umittatta. uverazin desifra dishlomo malka, ishtechach raza da, veukemuha butzina kaddisha, zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael.

Ketiv vayyinnafash, veukemuha vavy nefesh deavdat veshappir ihu. aval i hachi vavy gufa itzterich lememar, deminneh avdat nefesh. aval raza demilla, bevar nash it nefesh, denatla umashich legabbeh lehay rucha meerev shabbat. vehahu rucha sharya begavvav dehahi nefesh, vedayyra bah kol yoma deshabbeta. ucheden, hahu nefesh, yetera beribbuya vetoalta yattir mimma dehava.

Veal da taninan, kol nafshan deyisrael mitatteran beyoma deshabbeta, veitra dilhon, desharya hay rucha begavvavyyhu. kevan denafak shabbeta, vehahu rucha salleka leella, keden vavy lenefesh, deavdat ma deavdat. avdat hahu itra illaa, vehahu chela kaddisha dehava ba, veda hu vayyinnafash, vavy nefesh, deavdat ma deavdat.

Onatan dechakkimin, deyade razin illain, milelya deshabbeta lelelya deshabbeta, veokmuha. aval milla da shailna levutzina kaddisha, deha chazenan dehay kitra tattaa, nakta ma denakta bimama, uvelelya yahiv mezona lechol cheleh, kema deukemuha, dichtiv, (Mishlei 31:15) vattakam beod layla vattitten teref levetah vechok lenaaroteha. nakta bimama, veyahava belelya. vehasheta amar mar deziuuga ishtechach behay lelya.

Amar, vadday ziuuga ishtechach belelya da. may tama. begin dehay lelya, afrishat nishmatin lechol innun chakkimin, deyadin razin dechachmeta. vechibbura, veziuuga, la ishtechach beyoma achara bechol chedva, bela irbuveya (sefer acher ella begin da) achara, kegon da. begin deinnun nishmatin difligat, feligat lon bechakkimin, betzaddikim, bachaside kedka yeot. (sefer acher vetu bechol) uvechol lelya velelya, ziuuga ishtechach vadday. ematay befalgut lelya. veha okimna. aval la bechol sitrin kehay ziuuga.

Uvegin da, chakkimin deyadin razin, bayayn lesaddera shimmusha dilhon, behay lelya. may taama. begin dechol yome deshabbeta, it lon rucha achara deshara al alma, uvehay lelya it lon rucha achara kaddisha illaa, denachta livni kaddishin, vehahu rucha nashiv meattika dechol attikin, venachta lego nekuda tattaa, lemehav bah nayycha lecholla, veda itpelig lechol sitrin, leella vetatta, kema deat amar beni uven bene yisrael.

Vechad innun chakkimin, yatvin behahu rucha kaddisha, rucha illaa, baan leshammesha arsayyhu, dehay rucha amshich avatreh letatta, kol innun nishmatin kaddishin, veyartin kaddishe elyonin, behay rucha, nishmatin kaddishin livnehon kedka yeot.

ohc: Lishmot mattot avotam vegomer. ledivre rabbi yoshiyya ba hakkatuv lishlol pashtiyyut hannishma meamro "leelle", sheen hakkavvana hi al hannimnim bearvot moav, ella perush "keelle" shehem bene esrim. verabbi yonatan mefaresh shebba hakkatuv lomar shehagam shechalku lehannimnim bearvot moav, chazru hem vehorishu yotze mitzrayim vechazru virashum, keamram babbarayta (sifre) veze leshonam: kayyotze vaze atta omer bevae haaretz, ze natal sea veellu natlu shalosh sein, vehorishu avihem veyarshu hammetim et hachayyim vechazru vechalku beshave. ulederech ze yeduyyak al nachon amro yinchalu, shekkinna haddavar lannochalim, ma sheen ken matbea haddibbur ad atta, keamro techalek haaretz velo amar "yachleku", vechen amro tarbe nachalato vechulei, vechen amro yuttan nachalato velo amar "yikkach nachalato", yechalek et haaretz velo amar "yachleku haaretz". ha lamadta shead atta haya hakkatuv medabber asher yaase behanechil otam, umaamar "lishmot vegomer yinchalu" hu ma sheyyaasu hannochalim achar shehiggiatam hannachala, yinchaluha bederech ze keillu nachalu otah avotehem mehem vechozrim venochalim otah mehem, vehu amro yinchalu ki lo hizkir nose hammanchil lehalebish haddavar bo.

rashi: Rabbim omrim mi yarenu tov. rabbim miyyisrael yesh sheroin reshaim beosher uveshalva veomrim: mi yarenu tov lihyot ashirim umassige taava kaellu?

Nesa alenu. harem alenu lenes et or panecha, leshon "harimu nes" (Yeshayahu 62:10), "arim nissi" (Yeshayahu 49:22). lashon acher: nesa alenu. reflanbir belaaz, kemo "avne nezer mitnossot" (Zecharya 9:16). aval ani eni mekanne bahem, ki simcha netuna velibbi meet deganam vetirosham rabbu. batuach ani: im lemachisim kach, leose retzono al achat kamma vechamma, leatid, shehu yom kibbul secharam:
targum: Sagiin deamrin man yachaminana tava nesa alana nehor sevar appach Adonai:

ohc: Vattaamodna lifne moshe vegomer. befarashat behaalotcha (Bamidbar 9:6) perashti machloket abba chanan verabbi yoshiyya, gam lamma nechleku gam bemakom ze, ulefi ma shepperashti sham yityashshev amro gam ken kol hannesiim vehaeda lishte hassevarot, lehaomer cholkin kavod vechulei mikkan atta lamed sheafillu en rabbo cholek lo kavod min hassetam en hannesiim cholkim kavod leam haaretz, uleman deamar en cholkin vechulei mikkan titchayyev lomar sares hammikra vedarshehu vehaven. vetaam sheddibberu bizman shehayu yachad shivte yisrael, lomar divrehem bifne kullan kede sheyyedu teshuvato lahem shello yeararu achar kenisatam laaretz.

Uvesefer hazzohar hakkadosh parashat balak daf 205 amru veze leshonam: dechav bemadbera bemillula legabbe moshe, chashivu demoshe antir devavu, uvegin kach kerivu lekammeh demoshe veelazar vechol hannesiim vechol rashe avahan vechulei, ad kan. haddevarim yaggidu shemmefaresh taam maamar hannesiim vechol haeda, hu shehabbanot kinnesu otam lachashash sheyyintor moshe lahem evat avihem. uma sheamru bazzohar "vechol rashe avahan" hu perush amro "vechol haeda", vehuchrach lefaresh ken lefi ma shemmefaresh shehem kinnesu otam, lo yitkannesu haeda kullam zulat bemaamar moshe uvitkia bachatzotzrot kayyadua, laze peresh shehem rashe haavot.

Veyesh lehair ledivre hazzohar, ech yaale al daat hatztzadkaniyyot lachshod bechasher kemoshe? veulay sheeno ella lelammedenu derech hachayyim, uchemo shepperesh sham bazzohar veze leshono: mikkan man dechayish min dayyana yakrev achrine veyasge beguvere" ad kan, uchevar amru zichronam livracha (bava batra kayit:) shehabbanot chachmaniyyot hayu vetzadkaniyyot hayu, uleolam yodim hayu ki moshe lo yeavvel mishpat. o efshar shechashshu ki moshe yishpot bahem kemishpat hammitlonnim vehameraggelim shello natlu venehem chelek baaretz lefi sheddibberu baAdonai uvemoshe, laze kinnesu kol haamurim letzadded immo bammishpat kede shello yitte bedato lechovatam. o efshar shennitchakkemu baze kede sheyyargish moshe veyaase ma sheasa kaamur sham bazzohar, shennistallek min hammishpat vehikrivo lifne Adonai. venire shehagam shehaya yodea moshe shennotlot nachala, im kol ze asa chen lelammed ledayyanim sheroim shennechshadim baddin sheyyistalleku vechulei kederech sheasa hu. o efshar shechash lahem sheyyihyu kemitlonnim vesillek atzmo milletzadded bemishpatam vehikrivo lifne Adonai.
Lemor. tzarich ladaat lemi yomar, im lefinchas – lo haya tzarich lomar achar kach "lachen emor", shekkevar amar sheyyomar lo haddevarim, veod seder haddevarim yaggid shello chen hu.

Venire shennitkavven baze sheyyomar leyisrael devarim hanneemarim bainyan, vehakkavvana kede sheyyakkiru mifal tov sheasa lahem pinchas velo yisnauhu bishvil harigat hannasi, uvema shennimshach missibbato shechavat hammalach mehem ma shechavat, keamram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 82:) kaasher avaer besamuch:

rashi: Beshalom yachdav eshkeva veishan. im hayu yisrael beshalom yachdav immi, hayiti shochev veyashen betach velo hayiti yare mikkol tzar veoyev:
Levadad lavetach. kemo "betach badad en yaakov" (Devarim 33:28), leshon mivtach vasheket hu, sheeno tzarich lehoshiv geyasot immo:
targum: Bishlama kachada eshkov veedmoch min biglal deant hu Adonai bilchodoy besivra totvinani:

rashi: Retzitam. leshon ratzon:
targum: Arum la bigvurat sayfehon yeritu ara utekof edraehon la parkat lehon arum yeminach veedra gevuretach unehor ziv yekarach arum kol zeman daasiku veorayta itreeta vehon:

rashi: Mizmor shir. shel leviyyim (neviim):
Leyom hashshabbat. sheomrim oto beshabbatot, vehu medabber beinyan haolam habba shekkullo shabbat (rosh hashshana lo.):
targum: Shevacha veshira di amar adam kadmaa al yoma deshabbatta:

rashi: Tzavve yeshuot yaakov. gam labbaim acharenu:
targum: Ant hu malki elaha beidana hada paked purekanut devet yaakov:

ohc: Vehikravtem ola vegomer laAdonai parim vegomer. nire ki taam hameatat happarim yom yom, lefi sheyyesh shene sode sheviiyyot: haummot hem harabbim shivim ummot venimshelu lefarim, veyisrael gam ken hem bivchinat hashsheva besod bat sheva (Zohar chodesh 3 266.), vechol maasehem sheviiyyot: hakkarbanot bechol hammusafin shiva shiva, yamim tovim shiva shiva, hashshabbat sod shiva anfe ilan shebbo shoresh nishmatan shiva, tzaddikim shiva, veramaz Adonai keneged haummot harmuzim bapparim sheyyihyu mitmaatim veholchim.

Veramaz becheshbon ze kavua arbaa asar kevasim, lirmoz shete hadderagot shebbeyisrael shebbaim beremez hakkevasim, echad nistar veechad nigle. hannistar hem habberurim shetztzarich levarer mehaummot, vehannigle hem hamevarrim. velaze keshekkalim happarim ze lecha haot shekkala mehem hannistar velo yishshaaru ki im yisrael lemofet veot. vehu ma sheramaz Adonai bekarban yom atzeret shiva kevasim shehem livne yisrael tzon kedoshim, par hu hannishar mehaummot meanaf yishmael, ayil hu hannishar mibbene esav habba miyyitzchak, vehaven sod haddavar.

rashi: Vayyismechu ki yishtoku. haggallim:
Vayyanchem. vaynahagem:

Machoz. leshon gevul, umenachem chibbero im "vachazutechem et sheol" (yeshaya 28:18) – gevulenu, shello yikkanes bigvulenu. vechen "machaze el machaze shalosh peamim" (Melachim 1 7:4). betanchuma matzati:
targum: Vachadun arum shatkin vedabbarinun limchoz raayathon:

ohc: Tzav et bene yisrael vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma sidder parashat hakkarbanot bemakom ze achar minnuy yehoshua, velo bemakom shetztzivva al hakkarbanot befarashat emor, shehare mitzva zo muchrach atta lomar shennahaga mishshehukam hammishkan, vihoshua nismach bishnat haarbaim.

Veulay shebba lomar sheim yirtze yehoshua lehakeriv temidin umusafin mishshello sheeno rashshay, hagam sheddin tzibbur yesh lo kidmuchach mikkamma mekomot. laze sidder mitzva zo achar minnuy yehoshua, vetzivva bah shettihye mishshel tzibbur, keamro "tzav et bene yisrael" vegomer, lomar sheen hattemidim baim ella mishshel tzibbur. velaze kafal lomar veamarta alehem leikkuv. vedikdek gam ken beamro alehem velo amar lahem, lefi ma shepperashti befarashat "vayyera elav" (Bereshit 18:1) ki yirtze miut zulato, kemo chen bema shellefanenu heir otanu shekkavvanato lemaet. shuv raiti lerazal (yalkut shemauni) sheamru veze leshonam: lefi shehayu yisrael omrim, lesheavar hayu hammassaot nohagim vehattemidin nohagim, pasku hammassaot pasku hattemidin. amar hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: emor lahem sheyyihyu nohagin temidin, ad kan leshonam. veshivim panim lattora.

Et karbani lachmi vegomer. perush, lefi sheyyesh battemidin shelosha mine karban: echad – hakeravat hattamid, sheni – asirit haefa shel minchat hattamid, shelishi – hannesachim. keneged hakeravat hattamid amar karbani, ucheneged hammincha amar lachmi shennikret lechem, ushenehem kalil laishshim, laze amar leishshay, ucheneged hannesachim amar reach nichochi sheen bo ella reach, shehu eno laishshim ella yotzek al hayyesod veyored lashshitin. uvishlosha devarim dikdek lomar bechinnuy: karbani, lachmi, nichochi, lomar shekkullan shel hakkadosh baruch hu bore hakkol vaadayin birshuto, keamro (Tehillim 24:1) "laAdonai haaretz umeloah" uferashnuhu bimkomo. vedikdek gam ken lomar leishshay bechinnuy, lomar sheggam haesh hi shel hakkadosh baruch hu, umeatta ma sheyyisrael makrivin hu minnechasav shel habbore.

Laze nitchakkem Adonai venatan azhara veamar tishmeru, lomar sheim lo yaasu hinne hem gozlim nechasav veovrim belav. veamro lehakeriv li vegomer perush ki ma sheyyaasu hu hakeravat chelek minnechasav lefanav, aval ikkaran shel nechasim hem shel hammakom.

Od nitkavven baze lehodia sod hakkarban, shehu lekarev anfe hakkedusha shehem chelek Adonai, vehu ma shennitkavven beamro karbani bechinnuy elav, vehaven. veamro lachmi leishshay perush, lechem ze sheani metzavve lehavi laishshim sodo hu karbani, shekkesheole laAdonai reach nichoach mitkarvim kol nitzotze hakkedushsha shennitrachaku.

rashi: Yeshan appecha. kol hakkoes, nechirav motziin ashan:
targum: Sichla tava al yedoy deasaf lema elaha rechekta lealmin yitkef rugezach bean raayatach:

ohc: Vaydabber moshe vegomer bearvot moav vegomer. yesh lehair lamma hutzrach lomar bearvot moav, veim yesh tzorech behodaa zo haya lo lehazekiro bemitzvat Adonai kesheamar "vayyomer Adonai" vegomer? veulay shennitkavven lema sheamru zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 22:1) mashal leroe vechulei, ki bihyotam bearvot moav al yarden yerecho nigmera shemirat roe neeman vehechziram becheshbon. velaze gam ken hikdim hakkatuv lomar bitchillat happarasha vayhi achare hammaggefa, lehair sheafillu achar shehaya bahem hammaggefa bau lichlal cheshbon harishon. uletaam ze lo amar hakkatuv inyan ze bemitzvat Adonai, ki davar ze nogea lemoshe lehareot shello hifsidu hatztzon al yado.

Veim tomar, vahalo roani ki Adonai amar elav "seu et rosh", en kavvanato bemaamar ze lekabbelam bamminyan, ki lichsheyyihyu nimtzaim chaserim harebe en lo taana alav, sheeno dome limtziut haroe, ella hayta kavvanat Adonai kederech sheamru zichronam livracha mashal leroe shennichnas zeev leedro veharag bahem vechulei, umatza moshe derech laasot cheftzo bizman shehaya tzarich limnotam. veamro tevat lemor bemakom ze sheen lahem lemi yomru, perush sheamar lahem hammechuvvan haramuz bearvot moav, shehu rotze lehacheziram beminyan kede sheyyedu shello chasru mimminyanam harishon al yado. o yirtze ki hu mone otam al pi hanneemar lo meAdonai velo millibbo levad hu mone otam:

Avinu met bammidbar. taam amro met bammidbar, lishlol shello met bemitzrayim, vehakkavvana baze ben leman deamar nitchalleka levae haaretz ben leman deamar nitchalleka leyotze mitzrayim zo hi ikkar taanatam, leman deamar leyotze mitzrayim amru met bammidbar hare shehaya miyyotze mitzrayim, vedikdeku gam ken betevat bammidbar lomar shehaya mikkelal otam shennigzera alehem gezerat "bammidbar yippelu figrechem" (bammidbar 14:29) ha lamadta shehaya ben esrim kesheyyatza mimmitzrayim, uleman deamar nitchalleka haaretz levaeha hare gam hu mode shettachzor leyotze mitzrayim veyanchilu benehem, venogaat hayyerushsha lahem bachazara.

Od yitbaer al pi divre hazzohar (Zohar 10 157.) sheamar ki hammidbar hu mekom shelitat 100 harasha, vezo sibbat peron avonam techef umiyyad, ki lefi shehayu dorsim alav vechofin oto lo hayu massigim geder ze lishlot alav ad shehayu mitrappein minnega avonam, vehu amro met bammidbar perush bishvil heyoto bammidbar shezzulat ze haya Adonai maarich appo ad shehaya metakken maasav velo haya met.

Od yitbaer al derech ma sheamru bazzohar (chelek 3 205:) ki "bammidbar" leshon dibbur, ki bau lehasir millev moshe leval yachshod otam sheyyesh belibbam alav chas veshalom sheyyeavvel mishpatam, veamru avinu met bammidbar perush: ech yaale al haddaat sheyyachshevu davar ze? halo hemma rau et asher hemit Adonai avihem bishvil sheddibber bemoshe, veze ot lahem leharechik machshevot aven beish elohim. veamru reaya laddavar shemmitat avihem hayta bishvil sheddibber bemoshe, shehare lo haya betoch haeda vegomer, vedarshu zichronam livracha (sifre) shekkallu bedivrehem adat meraggelim vaadat korach umitlonnim, vehu lo haya benehem. ha lamadta shello haya lo ella chet haddibbur, shehare kamma kittot shel resha hayu velo nimna immahem. vehu ma sheggamru omer ki vecheto leshon yachid, perush: chet echad haya lo velo yoter. veulay ki laze nitkavvenu ledabber divrehem bifne kol hannesiim vehaeda lehashemiam devarim ellu lehagedil emat moshe belibbam. veefshar ki laze nitkavven beamro "lemor avinu met bammidbar", perush: taam "vattikravna lifne vegomer velifne" vegomer lemor davar ze – avinu met bishvil sheddibber bemoshe, hagam shehaya tzaddik gamur velo haya beyado ella chet echad.

Uvaze nityashsheva temihat hattosafot shehikshu sham beferek yesh nochalin (bava batra 118:) bedibbur hammatchil "uleman deamar levae haaretz" vechulei, shemmiddivre haggemara muchach ki leman deamar nitchalleka levae haaretz lo natlu habbanot chelek tzelafchad hannogea lo leatzmo benachala, ella hannogea lo benachalat chefer keshechazru lo banav. im ken lamma hutzrechu habbanot lomar "vehu lo haya betoch haeda" vegomer, vahalo afillu bene haeda shel hameraggelim natlu bizchut avi avihem? uledarkenu hutzrechu lomar "vehu lo haya" vegomer, lomar "ki vecheto" vegomer kemo shepperashti. vechutz middarkenu yesh leyashshev kushyat hattosafot shehabbanot lo yadu shello niknesu hammeraggelim littol bachazara benichse avihem, vechashvu sheppaka mehammeraggelim nachala baaretz kol ikkar, laze hutzrechu lomar "vehu lo haya" vegomer.

Uvanim lo hayu lo. velo amru en lo, yitbaer al derech amram bene vanim hare hem kevanim, veheelu baggemara (yevamot sav:) shehu haddin bene habbanot, laze amru lo hayu lo kevar aval yesh tikva sheyyihye lo, vehem asher yaldu benotav shehem nikraim gam ken banav:

Vayyomer Adonai vegomer lemor. amro lemor, perush shello yachshov moshe ki maamar "ken benot" vegomer hem haddevarim hanneemarim lemoshe shehikriv hammishpat veen tzorech leamram lezulat, laze amar "lemor" sheyyomar kemo chen lahem. veefshar shello lahem levad ella leyisrael, velaze lo amar "lemor lahem". o efshar mimma sheamar achar kach "veel bene yisrael" vegomer gilla ki ma shekkadam en tzorech leamro ki im livnot tzelafchad, uchefi ze amro "lemor" hu lemor labbanot.

Bene yehuda. parasha zo tirmoz meoraot am bene yisrael, uvachar lirmoz bihuda mehattaam atzmo sheamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 98,6) lamma nikreu yisrael al shem yehuda. amro bene yehuda hem hattoladot yittachnu beshem banim kayyadua, veamro er veonan yirmoz levayit rishon uvayit sheni, er keneged bayit rishon al derech amro (Shir HaShirim 5:2) "ani yeshena velibbi er", shehaya hakkadosh baruch hu bo er behashegacha gedola immanu babbayit hammekuddash, onan hu bayit sheni ukerao onan leshon onaa, lefi shehaya chaser devarim haikkarim shel bayit hammekuddash.

Veamro vayyamat er veonan hu churban habbattim, ki silluk shechina mehem yikkare mita, shepparcha hannefesh shehi hashshechina venishar habbayit met baavonot umale tumat hakkelippa hannetuna bo kayyadua. gam timtza sheavon shebbo met er hu heavon atzmo sheggaram hachurban, sheamru zichronam livracha (shabbat sav:) shehayu masrichin al mittotehem, vehu maase er, dichtiv (Bereshit 38:9) "veshichet artza", vaavon onan hu avon sheggaram churban bayit sheni shehaya lahem sinat chinnam (yoma 9:) uchemo chen onan dichtiv bo (sham) "levilti netan zera leachiv", gam leshon onaa shehayu meannim ze et ze.

Veamro beeretz kenaan, rasham makom hammekuddash ki hu beeretz kenaan, vesham mitato shechazar likkanes birshut 100 hannikra kenaan. gam yirmoz sibba achat kelalit, vehi sheyyisrael lo horishu hakkenaani venisharu yoshvim bah, veze sibbev lehattotam midderech hammusar kayyadua, vehu ma sheramaz bemaamar "beeretz kenaan".
