Veamro ben gilad ben machir ben menashshe, kevar heiru razal veamru besifre veze leshonam: maggid hakkatuv keshem shetztzelafchad haya bechor kach hayu kullan bechorot, ad kan. uchefi ze yechavven hakkatuv lehodia shennitorru gam bifrat ze littol chelek habbechora hannogaat lehaavot. od amru sham veze leshonam: lehodiacha shekkullan tzaddikim, shekkol mi sheyyichaso vechulei, ad kan. vechen mashma middivre Rashi bachumash. veamro veelle betosefet vav lomar ma harishonim tzelafchad chefer machir gilad kullam tzaddikim keamram zichrono livracha kemo shekkatavti besamuch, veelle gam ken tzaddikim kemotam.

Veelle shemot benotav. kashe amro benotav, shennire shello hizkir ella tzelafchad velo habbanot, shebbaze yutzdak lomar "veelle shemot benotav", velo chen hu, sheadrabba lo hizkir ella habbanot bechinnuy avihem, veim ken haya lo lomar "veelle shemotam".

Ulehavin hakkavvana air gam ken beseder shemot habbanot, sheroani sheen hakkatuv mesadderan beseder shave shemmazkiram bemakom acher, shekken timtza befarashat mase (Bamidbar 36:11) shessidderam shello keseder ze. uvemassechet bava batra (4 120) amru veze leshonam: lehallan menaan derech gedullatan vechan derech chachmatan. uferesh rashbam: "lehallan" hu befarashat mase bishat nissuin derech gedullatan, vechan", perush, keshebbau lifne moshe menaan derech chachmatan. veen haddevarim nirim mikkamma teamim: 1 – bamme mesuyyam haddavar ki menaan derech gedullatan beinyan hannissuin, ki mi yomar shehakkatuv derech nissuehen mane lehu. 2 – lamma keshemmenaam hakkatuv lemala (Bamidbar 26:33) bemispar bene menashshe lamma lo menaan derech gedullatan, vesham en devar chachma velo tevuna. 3 – middivre hattalmud kashe lamma hikdim lomar "lehallan" veachar kach amar "vechan" vechulei, kevan shekkavvanat amro "lehallan" hu haamur levassof befarashat mase, gam tevat "lehallan" peshatah hu mikkodem.

Achen hannachon beenay hu, ki seder gedullatan hu seder haamur bemispar bene menashshe vehaamur befasuk "vattikravna", veseder chachmatan hu seder haamur befasuk "vattihyena" vegomer, velaze amar hashshas "lehallan" vechulei, perush lefi shehashshas amar besamuch tzadkaniyyot hem shello nisseu ella lehagun lahem, veamar "lehallan" perush bazzikkaron hakkodem lezikkaron ze shel nissuin, vehu zikkaron haamur bemispar bene menashshe, gam befasuk "vattikravna" menaan keseder gedullatan, ki chen rauy lachush lomar derech gedullatan bezikkaron rishon lehodaat havayatan, vechan, perush bappasuk "vattihyena" sheanu oskin bo kaamur menaan derech chachmatan, vehodia bahem hakkatuv inyan ze shel derech chachmatan befaam acharona shehizkiram, aval bechol hammekomot lo hizkiram ella keseder gedullatan, uchefi ze yeduyyak divre hashshas al nachon.

Uvaze navo leyashshev ma shehikshenu bakkatuv, vehu shennitchakkem hakkatuv lehair ki derech gedullatan mone otam, velaze im haya omer "veelle shemotam" haya tzarich lesadderan keseder chachmatan, veseder chachmatan enah chen. velaze amar veelle shemot benotav lehaircha shesseder havayat banot meavihem hu shemmesadder hakkatuv. vechen timtza lemala bemispar bene menashshe shenneemru gam ken beseder ze, dikdek hakkatuv lomar "veshem benot tzelafchad" lehair kemo chen. vahagam sheggam befasuk "vattihyena" amar hakkatuv gam ken "benot tzelafchad", sham hikdim zichronam veachar kach shem avihem, veen bemashmauto shessidderan kederech ledatan, ella kesheyyakdim zichron haav veyismoch lezichrono zichronam – ze yaggid ki mone seder yetziatan mimmennu. veayyen ma shekkatavti befarashat noach befasuk (Bereshit 6:10) "vayyoled noach shelosha vanim".

targum: Ushevak yat toraya urehat batar eliyahu vaamar enshok kean leabba uleima veehach batrach vaamar leh ezel tuv are ma avadit lach:
Uvatar mashiryat malache zia eshta vela vemashiryat malache eshta shechinta dayya uvatar mashiryat malache eshta kal dimshabbechin bachashai:
Ushechiv udemoch techot ritma chad veha den malacha kerev beh vaamar leh kum echol:
Veisteche veha isadohi charara meaffa utzeluchita demaya vaachal ushete vetav ushechiv:
Vihe deyishtezev mecharba dachazael yiktol yehu udeyishtezev mecharba deyehu yiktol elisha:
Tav leodaa kodam Adonai uleshabbacha shemach ilaa:
Ushelach azgadin levat achav malka deyisrael lekarta:
Vaazal mittaman veashkach yat elisha bar shafat vehu rade bitre asar padnin detora tzemidin kadamohi vehu bechad mittere asra vaavar eliyahu levateh urema shoshifeh alohi:
Salkin tzet shemaya nachatin imke tehomaya nafshathon bevisha titmogeg:
Arum la bekashti ana rachitz vesayfi la tifrok yati:
Vekam vaachal ushete vaazal bechela daachilata hahi arbein yemamin vearbein lelavan ad daata letura deitgele alohi yekara dayya lechorev:
Vaatev malka deyisrael vaamar kefitgamach ribboni malka dilach nafshi vechol dili:
Vaamar Adonai leh ezel tuv leorchach lemadvera damasek utehach vetimshach yat chazael lemeheve malka al aram:
Ushelachat izevel izgada levat eliyahu lememar keden yabedun dachalatai ucheden yosfun elahen keidana haden mechar ashave yat nafshach kenafsha dechad minhon:
Vaamar leh kidnan amar bar hadad kaspach vedahavach dili hu uneshach uvenach shappiraya dili inun:
Vetav mibbatrohi unesiv yat padan toraya vehademeh uvemane toraya bashel lehon bisra vihav leama vaachalu vekam vaazal batar eliyahu veshamsheh:
Veashar beyisrael shava alfin kol rechuvaya dela cherau levala vechol puma dela neshak leh:
Uvar hadad malka daaram kenash yat kol mashiryateh utelatin uteren malkin imeh vesusevan uretichin uselek vetzar al shomron veagiach kerava bah:
Vetav malacha dayya tinyanut ukerev beh vaamar leh kum echol are sagi minach orcha:
Vehu halech bemadbera mahalach yoma vaata vitev techot ritma chad usheel yat nafsheh limmat vaamar sagi li arka ad ematay ana mitref keden kean Adonai sav nafshi are la tav ana meavahati:
Vetzalu kodam Adonai kad ayik lehon umimikathon yappek yathon:

Vaamar puk utekum betura kodam Adonai veha Adonai mitgele ukedamohi mashiryat malache rucha mefarkin turaya umetabberin kefaya kodam Adonai vela vemashiryat malache rucha shechinta dayya uvatar mashiryat malache rucha mashiryat malache zia vela vemashiryat malache zia shechinta daAdonai:
Yekim alola lishtikuta veyishtekun gallehon:
Veruach gevura min kodam Adonai havat im eliyahu vezarez chartzeh urehat kodam achav ad daata leyizreel:
Yehevta chedvata velibbi min idan deibburehon vechamrehon sagiu:
Veal taman limarta uvat taman veha fitgama dayya imeh vaamar leh ma lach ka eliyahu:
Veyat yehu var nimshi timshach lemeheve malka al yisrael veyat elisha bar shafat mimeshar mechola timshach lemeheve neviya techotach:
Vechave achav leizevel yat kol di avad eliyahu veyat kol diktal yat kol neviye shikra becharba:
Vaamar kanaa kaneti kodam Adonai elaha tzevaot are shevaku keyamach bene yisrael yat madbechach fagaru veyat neviyach ketalu vecharba veishtaarit ana vilchodi uveo yat nafshi lemiktelah:
Vachaza vekam vaazal leshezava nafsheh vaata liver sheva di leshivta yehuda ushevak yat ulemeh taman:
Vahava kad shema eliyahu ucherich appohi beshoshifeh unefak vekam bitra mearta veha imeh kala vaamar ma lach ka eliyahu:
Vaamar kanaa kaneti kodam Adonai elaha tzevaot are shevaku keyamach bene yisrael yat madbechach pagaru veyat neviyaych ketalu becharba veishtaarit ana vilchodi uveo yat nafshi lemiktelah:

bart: Ketzad mevattelah. nachri laashera:
Kirsem. kesamim yeveshim shebbailan netalan letzarko lisrof:
Vezerad. karat anafim lachim shebbah:
Shefayah. targum vaekkot oto tachon (Devarim 9), veshafit yateh:
Letzarkah. kede leyappotah. veen mevattel avoda zara ella nachri gadol uven daat sheyyeda betiv avoda zara umeshammesheha. vaafillu im bittelah beal karcho hare zo mevuttelet:
Im yesh lo alav milva asur. im yesh lo al hayyayin milva, shezze hayyayin meshubad lo vechovo, az hu chemamono venaga beh lirot heach hu:
Nafal. hannachri levor male yayin:
Veala. met. af al gav denaga beshaa shennafal eno asur bahanaa, hoil velo nitkavven ligga. aval ala chay, baaliyyato osro, mishshum demode laavoda zara al shennitztzol:
Umedado vakkane. o shehaya hannachri moded yeno shel yisrael bekane:
Vehittiz. o shehittiz hannachri et hatztzira miyyeno shel yisrael al yede hakkane velo naga beyadav bayyayin:
Hammeruttachat. shehayta hechavit maala retichot, vetafach hannachri veyado al hartichot, en derech nissuch bechach:
Verabbi shimon mattir. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Ze haya maase vehichshiru. af bishtiyya:
Shelosha vattim hem. leinyan bittul avoda zara:
Bayit. shettechillat binyano laavoda zara, vehayu ovdin et habbayit atzmo, hare ze asur:
Siyyedo vechiyyero laavoda zara. shehaya vanuy mittechilla ledirat adam, vesiyyedo, shellibbeno vassid. vechiyyero, pittuach vetziyyur:
Vechiddesh. o shechiddesh:
Notel ma shechiddesh. ushear kol habbayit muttar:
Hichnis letocho avoda zara. lefi shaa velo hiktzahu letashmish avoda zara:
Shalosh avanim hem. leinyan bittul:
Even shechatzavah mittechilla. min hahar:
Levimos. lehoshiv avoda zara aleha:
Siyyedah vechiyyerah. vehi hayta chatzuva veomedet:
Notel. yisrael:
Ma shechiddesh. hannachri, vehaeven mutteret:
Heemid aleha avoda zara. lefi shaa velo hiktza haeven levimos:
Vesillekah, hare zo mutteret. veenah tzericha vittul:
Giddeo. leshem avoda zara, laavod haggiddulim sheyyigdelu vo meatta:
Notel ma shehechelif. haanafim sheggadlu vimkom otan sheggiddea, vesorfan kedin ashera, vehashshear muttar:

Ezo hi ashera. baggemara mefaresh, deashshalosh asherot ditnan leel kae. vehachi katane, shalosh asherot hen, shetayim divre hakkol, veachat machloket rabbi shimon verabbanan, veezohi ashera shennechleku rabbi shimon verabbanan, kol sheyyesh tachteha avoda zara, derabbanan karu la ashera veasre la kol zeman sheyyesh avoda zara tachteha, verabbi shimon omer enah ashera ella kol sheovdin otah, aval kol sheyyesh tachteha avoda zara en zo ashera. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Natal mimmenna. min haashera:

Chadash yuttatz. shehahessek harishon shemmassikin hattannur hu mechassemo umachaziko, vahare nitkan beissure hanaa. veha matnitin ate allibba deman deamar ze vaze gorem asur. veen halacha. hilkach ben chadash ben yashan yutztzan, shello yofu vo et happat behessek ze ad sheyyitztannen hattannur, kede shello yehane meatze issur:

Happat asura. baggemara kaamar, vehu sheavuka chenegdo, shekkol shaa shehaya fat neefe haya dolek haur befi hattannur veofehu, shehaya nehene min haissur beshaa shehaya haissur been veyesh shevach etzim bappat:
Yolich hanaa leyam hammelach. deme chikkar shennitarev:

Karkor. yesh laorgim etz asuy kemin machat shel sakkain, umaavirin oto al hashsheti keshehu matuach lifnehem baariga. veashmeinan matnitin pelugta derabbi eliezer verabbanan behanach tarte, dei ashmoinan bekammayta, hava amena behach kaamar rabbi eliezer mishshum dividna deka gamra fat ikkele leh issura, aval karkor deita leissura veeneh ema mode lehu lerabbanan. vei ittemar behaich, beha kaamre rabbanan, aval bekammayta ema modu leh lerabbi eliezer, tzericha. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer, vaafillu chavit shel yen nesech shennitarva vechaviyyot shel yayin shel hetter molich deme otah chavit leyam hammelach, vehashshear kullan muttarot bahanaa:
Habbasar bachamishsha. kaevarim shel keves kach evarim shel ayil:
Hassolet. shene esronim haya, bishne kohanim:

Dorchin im haggoy baggat. velo amrinan mistakker beissure hanaa hu, daafillu vishtiyya savar hay tanna deshare kol zeman shello yarad labbor. umishshum gorem tuma lekka, shemmishshaa sheddarach bahem hannachri meat, nitmeu, venimtza sheen hayyisrael gorem tuma:

Aval lo votzrin immo. lefi shennotnam begat temea, vehannachri metamme haanavim bemaggao, vehayyisrael habbotzer immo gorem tuma. vesavar hay tanna asur ligrom tuma lechullin shebbeeretz yisrael vaafillu hem shel nachri. veen halacha kemishna zo, dekayma lan kevan shehitchil hayyayin lehimmashech naase yen nesech, hilkach en dorchin im haoved kochavim baggat. vekayma lan muttar ligrom tuma lechullin shebbeeretz yisrael keshehachullin hem shel nachri, hilkach botzrin im hannachri, veaf al pi sheggorem tuma lechullin en bechach kelum. umihu yisrael habbotzer karmo lechattechilla lo yikkach nachri immo afillu lehavi anavim laggat, mishshum lech lech amrinan nezira kulei‏:
Veyisrael haose ferotav betuma. over avera hu, lefi shehu metamme hatterumot vehammaasrot shebbahem. hilkach asur lesayyeo, kede shello yehe ragil bechach:
Aval molichin immo. chaviyyot rekaniyyot laggat: umeviin immo. chaviyyot meleot min haggat. demay dahava hava, meachar shennitmeu muttar litten hayyayin bechaviyyot temeot:

Ben haulam velammizbeach. kol tzefon haazara haya kasher min haddin lehaamadat happar, dechullah lifne Adonai‏ hi, velo hayu maamidim happar ben haulam ulemizbeach karov lahechol ella mishshum chulesha dechohen gadol, shello yichbad alav torach massa mizrak haddam lemerachok:

Rosho laddarom ufanav lammaarav. bedin haya sheyyihye rosho lahechol, shehu bammaarav vaachorav lammizbeach, ella shemma yatil gelalim ugenay hu lehareot bet hari shello letzad mizbeach, lefichach haya rosho laddarom uzenavo latztzafon dehachi shappir tefe, veemtza gufo ben haulam velammizbeach, veikkem rosho ad sheyyihyu panav lammaarav:
Vehakkohen omed. vaachorav lammizrach:
Achal achad mehen. tana tuma deorayta vekatane tuma derabbanan. ufelugetayhu derabbi yehuda verabbi yose hacha nammi beva lishshael alav veal chavero, kiflugetayhu leel. vahalacha kerabbi yose:

Taraf bakkalpi. taraf chataf velakach pitom bachatifa bakkalpi, sheshshaninu lemala vekalpi hayta sham. velamma bachatifa, kede shello yitkavven lehakkir bemishmusho eze shel shem veyittelennu beyamin, lefi shessiman yafe haya keshehaya ole beyamin:
Veheela shene goralot. echad beyamin veechad bismol. vehasseirim omdim echad leyamin veechad lismol, venatan goral sheala beyamin al sair shel yamin vegoral sheala bismol al sair shel semol:
LaAdonai‏ chattat. shem hameforash haya mazkir, vehu shem shel yod hei kemo shehu nichtav:
Rabbi yishmael omer lo haya tzarich kulei. veen halacha kerabbi yishmael:
Vehen onim acharav. keshemmazkir et hashshem:
Odyarin. habballanin baale hammerchatzaot yesh lahen challonot challonot, vechol mi shennichnas lammerchatz noten begadav kol echad bechallon venoel alav baddelet shebbachallon:
Rabbi elazar ben azarya metaher. mishshaa shennaal haddelet bifne hachallon. velo chayshinan shemma yigga sham adam tame, meachar shennitpas alav kegannav:
Ad sheyyitten letocho mafteach. veaf al pi shennoten hammafteach beyad habballan shehu am haaretz, ha tenan leel hammoser mafteach leam haaretz habbayit tahor:
O ad sheyyaase lo siman. lehakkir bo shello naga adam sham. vahalacha kachachamim:
Hammanniach et kelav. kelim shebbatzar bahem betohora beshana zo, manniach otam livtzor bahem betohora leshana habbaa:
Benachri kelav tehorin. garsinan. kelomar im hinnichan etzel nachri en bahem mishshum issur yen nesech, delo chayshinan shemma lekachan hannachri belo yediat yisrael laasot baggat:

Uveyisrael. dechoshesh lahen mishshum tumat magga, temeim im hissiach dato mehen, ad sheyyomar belibbi haya leshamram. veyesh sefarim delo garse benachri, ella hammanniach keli miggat zo legat habbaa kelav tehorim, umayre bechohen hallokeach yayin shel teruma meam haaretz umanniach kelav etzlo kede sheyyikkach mimmennu laggat habbaa, vehoil vechelim shel kohen hen, mirtat am haaretz velo naga behu. aval im hakkelim hen shel yisrael sherotze laasot yeno betohora, lo mizdehar behu am haaretz kulle hay, vechayshinan dilma naga bahen adam tame, im hissiach dato mehen, ad sheyyomar belibbi haya leshamram:
Nodot. shel or:
Vekankannim. shel cheres:

En issuran issur hanaa. vedinayhu hachi, im chadashim hem, muttar latet letochan yayin miyyad. veim hichnis bahen hannachri yayin lekiyyum, memalle otam mayim umashhe vetochan shelosha yamim meet leet, ella shemmeare hammayim bechol yom meet leet shel shelosha yamim umesim mayim acherim tachtehem, veachar kach muttar lasum betocho yayin. veim yashnu shenem asar chodesh shello haya vahem yayin shel nachrim, muttarin miyyad achar shana beli eruy:
Chartzannim vezaggim. pesolet shel anavim, garinim shebbifnim vehakkelippim shebbachutz:
Lachim. kol shenem asar chodesh asurim bahanaa:
Viveshim. leachar shenem asar chodesh muttarin afillu vaachila:
Hammuryas. shumman shel dagim. uregilin hayu shemmearvin bo yayin. aval im nikkar mimmennu shello nitarev bo yayin, kulle alma lo felige deshare:

Bet unyaki. shem kefar, sherov agalim hannimtzaim sham kerevim laavoda zara. rabbi meir chayesh lemiuta vesavar deaf al gav derov agalim havu miuta keneged shear behemot, chayshinan lemiuta, vechol haggevinot hannimtzaot sham amrinan dilma vekevat egle avoda zara heemidan. vachachamim lo chayshe lemiuta. veen halacha kerabbi meir bechol hane telata bave:
Ben katin. kohen gadol haya:

Asa shenem asar dad lakkiyyor. kede sheyyihyu shenem asar kohanim hazzochim bappayis shel tamid shel shachar mekaddeshim bevat achat. veaf al pi sheshshelosha asar kohanim hayu kidamran befirka barishona, lo asa dad lashshochet, shehashshechita keshera bezar:
Mucheni. galgal leshakkeo babbor, sheyyihyu memav mechubbarim babbor velo yippaslu belina:
Nivreshet. menora:
Shepparashat sota chetuva aleha. velo yitztarech lehavi tora lichtov mimmenna parashat sota:
Nikanor. shem adam:

Naasu nissim ledaltotav. shehalach laalekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim lehavi delatot, uvachazarato amad saar gadol bayyam letabbean, natlu achat mehen vehetiluha bayyam lehakel mealehem, bikkeshu lehatil haacheret, amar lahem hatiluni immah, miyyad nach hayyam mizzapo. kevan shehiggiu lannamel shel akko hayta mevatzbetzet veyatza mittachat dafne hassefina:
Hametaher yeno shel nachri. yisrael sheddarach anavim shel nachri bechashrut kede lemachro leyisrael, veeno noten maot lannachri ad sheyyimkerennu leachar zeman:
Venotno virshuto. shel nachri:

Beir sheyyesh bah nachrim veyisreelim muttar. demirtat nachri dilma chazu leh hanach yisrael deavre virshut harabbim umafsidna. vaafillu en mafteach vechotam, share. vehu sheen lo milva al oto yayin, kegon shekkatav lo hitkabbalti mimmecha, kidamrinan lekamman:

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer kol reshut nachri achat hi. pelugta derabbi shimon ben elazar vetanna kamma, detanna kamma savar keshehinniach yisrael yayin birshuto shel nachri baal hayyayin, hu devainan sheyyehe habbayit patuach lirshut harabbim veir sheyyisrael venachrim darim bah. aval birshut nachri acher sheeno baal habbayit, afillu veir sheen yisrael darim bah, share. verabbi shimon ben elazar omer, kol reshut nachri achat hi, vechi hechi devirshut hannachri baal hayyayin asur ella veir sheyyisrael venachrim darim bah vehabbayit patuach lirshut harabbim, hachi nammi birshut nachri acher, tzarich ir sheyyisrael venachrim darim bah uvayit patuach lirshut harabbim. vahalacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar. uvizman shemmafteach vechotam beyad yisrael, ben birshut baal hayyayin ben birshut nachri acher, muttar ledivre hakkol:
Basilki. pelatya gedola. vehachi amrinan beferek 2‏ deyoma [daf kad] lishkat haggazit kemin basilki gedola hayta:
Veroe et hannichnasin veet hayyotzin. dechi roe hannichnasim vehayyotzim chashiva reshut hayyachid tefe. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Chadashim lakketoret. kach hayu machrizin baazara. kelomar mi shello zacha bakketoret kol yamav yavo veyafis. velo hayu mannichin lemi shezzacha bah paam achat lishnot bah, mippene shemmaasheret, dichtiv (Devarim 33) yasimu ketora beappecha vechulei‏ barech Adonai‏ chelo, ulefi shekkol kohen hammaktir ketoret haya mitashsher umitbarech bishvilah, lefichach lo hayu mannichin lishnot bah adam, kede sheyyihyu hakkol mitashsherim umitbarchim bah:
Chadashim gam yeshanim. mi shezzacha bappayis peamim acherot, umi shello zacha bo meolam, bou vahafisu:

Mi maale evarim min hakkevesh lammizbeach. keshehayu molichin haevarim mibbet hammitbachayim lo hayu molichim otam lammizbeach ella notnim otam mechatzi kevesh ulematta bammizrach, umefisin payis acher mi maale otam mimmekom hannachatan bakkevesh lammizbeach. vehayu osin ken mishshum berov am haderat melech:

Tzurat chamma tzurat levana. peresh harambam zichrono livracha, lo sheyyimtza iggul veyomar zehu hashshemesh, o chemin keshet agol veyomar zo levana, ella sheyyimtza hatztzura shemmeyachasim ellu hovre shamayim lashshemesh veyareach, kemo sheamru shetztzurat hashshemesh tzurat melech meuttar yoshev al agala, vechen kol kayyotze vaze:

Tzurat derakon. tzurat nachash sheyyesh lo tzitzin vekaskassin kekaskasse haddag, veomrim shehi tzura litli hallevana, vehayta neevedet beotan hayyamim. vaafillu lerabbanan deamre leel shear kol hatztzelamim muttarin, modu dehanach asire, deorchayhu lemiflechinhu:
Sheal hamechubbadim. kelim naim shettashmishan lenoy ulechavod, kegon sherim unezamim vetabbaot vechayyotze vahem:
Mevuzzim. kegon yorot vekumekumesim umechamme chammin vedomehen. vahalacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Vezore laruach. shello yehane yisrael mimmenna:
Af hu. im yizrennu laruach gam atta yesh hanaa leyisrael mimmennu, shehi naaset zevel:
Pirche chehunna. bachurim shemmatchil sear zekanam lifroach keruyin pirche:

Beetzba tzereda. haetzba hassemucha laagudal. uleshon tzereda, tzarta deda, kelomar tzaratah shel haagudal hassemucha lah, hayu mechabberim haagudal baetzba hassemucha lah veshomtah umakke al kappo umashmia kol kede shello yishan kohen gadol:
Amod. al raglecha:
Vehafeg achat al haritzpa. shel shayish, lehasir chummam, shetztzinnun haraglayim mesir hashshena. vehafeg leshon hasara, kemo mefigin taaman [betza yad.]:
Amar lahem hammemunne. hu hassegan:
Tzeu ureu. al makom gavoah shehaya lahem bammikdash:
Zeman hashshechita. shehashshechita pesula ballayla, shenneemar (Vayikra 19) beyom zivchachem:
Barkay. heir vehivrik hashshachar:
Heir pene hammizrach. zeman ze achar barkay deamar tanna kamma. vahalacha kemattitya ben shemuel:
Ad shebbechevron. otan haomdin lematta shoalin lo, higgia haor lechevron, vehu meshiv, hen. uchede lehazekir zechut avot mazkirin chevron:
Bizman shehu roe. bizman shebbaal habbayit yachol lirot hannichnasin babbayit vehayyotzin min habbayit:
Hoochalin vehammashkin vechulei‏ temein. dechayshinan shemma naga bahen hashshomer hazze shehu am haaretz:
Aval hammishkavot vehammoshavot vechulei‏ tehorin. sheen am haaretz ose mishkav umoshav veeno metamme behesset, delo gazru ella al tumat maggao bilvad:
Velo et hayyoshvim. af al pi sheim omed roehu, kevan sheeno roe et hayyoshev, hakkol tame:
Afillu muval. afillu haya hashshomer hazze shehu am haaretz, muval, sheeno yachol lelech ella im ken movilim oto:
Vaafillu kafut. kashur:
Hakkol tame. shello metammeinan lehu mishshum mishkav umoshav shel am haaretz, ella mishshum dechayshinan shemma nichnas sham nachri o ishsha nidda veyashva vehissita vetimmea et hakkol:
Shehinnichuha ovdeha. veen datam lachazor:
Bishat shalom mutteret. hoil veyatzu ledaat velo netaluha immahem, bitteluha:

Bimosyaot shel melachim. avne gazit hametukkanot bederech mahalach hammelech, ucheshehammelech over sham moshivim sham avoda zara vehu mishtachave lah. uvaggemara mefaresh, mippene shemmannichin otah, kelomar enan meyuchadot lehoshiv sham avoda zara chol shaa ella veshaa shehammelachim ovrim, ufeamim shehammelachim ovrim bederech acheret veen choshshin lahem, hilkach lav meshammeshe avoda zara chashive:
Ala lerosho. rosho shel ilan chashuv reshut hayyachid:

Hichnis yado lechor sheyyesh bo tuma. hachor chashuv reshut hayyachid, veaf al pi shehaadam omed birshut harabbim, kevan shehichnis yado lachor, keomed birshut hayyachid dame. veaf al gav dehailan vehachor lo havu reshut hayyachid etzel shabbat, havu reshut hayyachid etzel tuma:

Chanut shehu tame ufatuach lirshut harabbim. haveya kol hachanut kullah ketuma hammunnachat birshut harabbim, ucheshem sheim haya sheretz birshut harabbim safek naga bo safek lo naga sefeko tahor, hacha nammi safek nichnas lachanut ze safek lo nichnas, sefeko tahor. aval im hayu shete chanuyyot achat tehora veachat temea, safek lattame nichnas safek lattahor nichnas, sefeko tame, dehavya leh sefek tuma birshut hayyachid:
Makom shehaya reshut hayyachid venaasa reshut harabbim. kegon bika, devimot haggeshamim reshut hayyachid uvimot hachamma reshut harabbim:
Hamesukkan. mi shennitallef veen yadua mimmennu im chay im met:
Vehecheziruhu lirshut hayyachid. vesham rauhu shemmet:

Keshehu virshut hayyachid sefeko tame. umetammeinan missafek kol adam vechelim shehayu immo birshut hayyachid shehaya sham barishona. veadam vechelim shehayu immo birshut harabbim leachar shehotziuhu mershut hayyachid, tehorin, disfek tuma birshut harabbim hu, usefeko tahor:

Rabbi shimon omer reshut harabbim mafsaket. kevan dechashvinan leh kechay leachar shehotziuhu mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim, umetaharinan lechelim veadam shehayu immo birshut harabbim deshemma chay hu, ech nachshevehu met lemafrea kodem sheyyatza mershut hayyachid, al karchach en yecholin letamme missafek adam vechelim shehayu immo birshut hayyachid barishona, hoil ureshut harabbim shehotziuhu sham baacharona mafseket sheatta machashivo kechay umetahart adam vechelim shehayu immo sham. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Im nishalu. kol echad lachachamim al sefeko bifne atzmo, en bet din yecholin letammean, deha kayma lan sefek tuma birshut harabbim sefeko tahor. veim bau bevat achat, hoil uvehoraa achat yesh lanu lomar temein attem o tehorim attem, i efshar lanu lomar tehorim attem, shehare echad vadday tame:

Rabbi yose omer ben kach uven kach temein. lo nechleku rabbi yose verabbi yehuda keshebbau lishshael bevat achat, dedivre hakkol temein. ucheshebbau lishshael ze achar ze divre hakkol tehorim. al ma nechleku, al habba lishshael alav veal chavero, derabbi yehuda medamme leh leze achar ze, verabbi yose medamme leh levat achat. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Hen muttarin. heharim atzman muttarin lizria velachtzov mehen avanim, dimchubbar lo mittesar:

Umippene ma ashera asura. kelomar ki hechi dedarshinan elohehem al heharim velo heharim elohehem, hachi nammi tachat kol etz raanan elohehem, velo etz raanan elohehem, velama asra tora dichtiv (Devarim 7) vaasherehem tegaddeun:

Mippene sheyyesh bah tefisat yede adam. sheadam netao. vesavar rabbi yose sheilan shennetao ulevassof avado asur. vetanna kamma savar, hoil uvitchillat netiato lo nitkavven leavdo, en haavoda sheoved oto achar shehu mechubbar osarto, dahave kemi sheoved lehar. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Ani ovin. afaresh:

Veadun lefanecha. achare sheen lanu lidrosh miut mittachat kol etz raanan, yesh lomar shello neemar ella limsor lahem simanim, makom shergilim emoriyyim laavod sham avoda zara kede sheyyechappesum yisrael vivaarum. umiuta deharim ugevaot miha memaatinan mimmashmauteh shello tzivva lanu leabbed heharim. aval etz raanan tzivva lanu leabbed shenneemar (sham 12) vaasherehem tisrefun baesh:
Memares. megis umenaer umearev bo, shello yikpe kesheyyishhe ad sheyyaase avodat hakketoret:

Al haroved harvii. kol shura veshura shel avne haritzpa keruya roved. vei efshar lefaresh roved harvii shebbahechol, shura reviit shebbetoch hahechol mippetach hahechol velifnim, deha ketiv (Vayikra 16) vechol adam lo yihye beohel moed vechulei, ella tane roved revii shel hechol, kelomar roved harvii shebbaazara, kesheyyotze min hahechol laazara mone et harvadin umannicho al haroved harvii, vesham omed hamemares bo. deillu betoch hahechol i efshar kidamran:
Vechote. et haggechalim umanniach et hammachta ad sheyyachpon bechafnav hakketoret veyitten letoch hakkaf, veachar kach yachnis kaf umachta lifnim:

Sefek bia tahor. mishshum devainan dumeya desota, devadday nistera ella desafek naga safek lo naga, delo yadinan im nitmet, vekarye rachamana temea, dichtiv (Bamidbar 4) venistera vehi nitmaa. aval sefek bia tahor:
Pechasah. befaneha. miacha bekurenas ad shehesir tzurat paneha:
Gerarah. sachov vehashelech betoch hattit:
Enah betela. dilfum shaa ratach ala, vahadar palach la:
Rabbi omer bittelah. pelugta derabbi verabbanan keshemmecharah lenachri, aval mecharah leyisrael tzoref divre hakkol betela. vahalacha kachachamim:
Matza verosho. shel markulis:

Maot kesut o chelim hare ellu muttarim. vehu shello yehu munnachin lenoy, kegon sheyyihyu hammaot munnachim bechis kashur vetaluy lo al tzavvaro, kesut mekuppelet umunnachat al ketefo o al rosho, kelim nammi munnachim al rosho, shekkol ellu enam derech noy:
Haistevanit. makom tzar keamma rochav, gavoah arbaa o chamishsha tefachim, omed lifne hachanuyyot shehassocharim yoshvim sham:
Bamme devarim amurim. devainan kol hane kohanim lechol behema uvainan payis:
Im ratza lehakeriv. kohen yechidi et hakkol uvelo payis:
Hefshetan venittuchan. shel yachid veshel tzibbur shavin lihyot kesherim bezar, veen teunin kohen:
Mesaruhu zikne vet din. shekkaru lefanav beseder hayyom:
Lezikne kehunna. lelammedo chafinat hakketoret, shenneemar (sham 16) umelo chafnav ketoret sammim. vaavoda kasha hayta:
Bet avtinas. hem haosim et hakketoret vechotshim otah umearvin sammaneha:

Vehishbiuhu. shello yehe tzedoki letakken hakketoret al hammachta mibbachutz ulehachnis mibbifnim, shehem dorshin ki veanan erae al hakkapporet (Vayikra 16), ki veanan ashan hakketoret yavo veaz erae al hakkapporet. veen haddavar ken, shehare hakkatuv omer (sham) venatan et hakketoret al haesh lifne Adonai:
Hu foresh uvoche. shechashaduhu litzdoki:
Vehen porshin uvochin. al shechashaduhu. deamar mar [shabbat 97.] hachoshed bichsherim loke begufo:
Afroditi. tzurat kochav noga. kach peresh harambam zichrono livracha:
En meshivin. devar tora vammerchatz, lefi sheadam omed sham arom:

Hi vata bigvuli. shehammerchatz kadam lah, vehammerchatz naasa lechol habba lirchotz. veod teshuva acheret, en omrin naase merchatz noy leafroditi, demerchatz lav davar shel noy hu, ella naase afroditi noy lammerchatz, sheafroditi meshammesh lammerchatz, hu tafel vehi ikkar:
Biv. charitz asuy bakkarka lehotzi shofchim lirshut harabbim:
Ella vefayis. ze shepperashnu:

Arbaa feyasot hayu sham. arba peamim bayyom neesafim lefayyes. velo hayu mefayyesim al kullam baasefa achat, kede lehashemia kol arba peamim sheyyesh am rav baazara, vezehu kevodo shel melech, shenneemar (tehillim noah) bevet elohim nehallech beragesh:

Hakkaddar shehinniach et kederotav. mocher hakkederot shehu chaver, shehinniach kederotav birshut harabbim, uregilin latet betzidde reshut harabbim avanim gedolot o yetedot leharechik haagalot shello yazziku hakketalim, umittoch shehayetedot hallalu dochakot et reshut harabbim, veze hinniach kederot etzlam, dachak gam hu et hadderech yoter, vehaovrin mitchakkechim bahen uvigdehem ovrim al pi aviran, uvigde am haaretz temein hen umetammein et hachitzoniyyot:
Bamme devarim amurim bemuttarot. shehaovrim veshavim massitin otan:
Aval baagudot. shei efshar lehassitan, hakkol tahor. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Shello masar lo ella shemirat hammafteach. velo samcha dateh lehikkanes, mippene shehu nitpas alav kegannav:
Kol hatztzelamim asurim. bahanaa:
Shehem neevadim paam achat bashshana. keshehashshemesh beotah maala shehatztzelem asuy bo. deaf al gav deikka tuva sheenan ella lenoy veenan neevadin, rabbi meir letameh dechayesh lemiuta:

Kol sheyyesh beyado vechulei. dehane vadday neevadim hem, demishshum chashivutayhu ashkelinhu lehanach cheftze bidayhu. vehosifu alehem babberayta, cherev vaatara vetabbaat. vahalacha kachachamim. veen asurin ella kesheomdin al petach hammedina. uvakkefarim sheen darkan laasot tzurot lenoy, divre hakkol asurin vaafillu en beyado davar, dilmiflechinhu avde lehu:
Hattame omed. metzora omed tachat haohel o tachat hailan:

Vetahor over. derech sham, safek naga safek lo naga, o safek heehil haohel o hailan al shenehem venitma hattahor, safek lo heehil velo nitma. o shehaya hattahor omed vehammetzora over. perush acher, kegon hashsheretz befi hachulda vehannevela befi hakkelev, avru ben hattehorim, o hattehorim avru benehen, chachamim metaharim im safek naga safek lo naga, mippene sheen lattuma makom, keditnan leel perek hazzorek tuma. ulefi perush ze, safek heehil safek lo heehil lekka leokma ahach resha detame omed vetahor over, divtumat ohel en chilluk ben yesh makom lattuma ben en makom lattuma, kidhochachnu leel perek hazzorek tuma:
Tuma virshut hayyachid vetohora virshut harabbim. kegon chanut happetucha lirshut harabbim, safek nichnas safek lo nichnas:

Rabbi yehoshua metamme. desavar safek birshut hayyachid verabbim hameshuttafim bo, batar reshut hayyachid azlinan usefeko tame. verabbanan savre, batar reshut harabbim azlinan usefeko tahor. veen halacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Pillusin. butz dak veyafe habba meeretz raamses, targum yerushalmi raamses, pillusa:
Hinduin. meeretz hodu:
Uven haarbayim. begadim shellovesh lehotzaat kaf umachta:
Hakkol sheloshim mane. lehachi hadar kelalinhu vetana, leashmoinan dishloshim mane sach hakkol lomar lecha sheim pichet leotan shel shacharit veribba leotan shel arvit let lan bah:
Im ratza lehosif mosif mishshello. uvilvad sheyyitten oto tosefet mattana lahekdesh:
Veyisrael roehu. lav davka roehu, ella chevan dei kae chaze leh af al gav dechi yatev lo chaze leh, hannachri irtote mirtat, amar hasheta kae vechaze li:

Vehaddavdaniyyot. hachallot sherodin min hakkavveret shebbahem haddevash, af al pi shehen notfot lo chayshinan shemma erav bahem yen nesech. perush acher, eshkolot shel anavim. af al pi shehayyayin notef mehen en bahen mishshum yen nesech, veen bahem mishshum hechsher mashke sheyyehe muchshar letuma, distaman laachila velo nicha leh bammashke hannotef mehen:
Vetarit sheenah terufa. veaf al gav shehi asuya chatichot, [nishar] rosh haddag veshidrato kayyamin venikkar shehu tahor:
Ale shel chiltit. deha lo mafseku leh besakkin:
Vezetim geluskaot megulgalim. zetim hakkenusim bichli agol umitchammemim veneetzarim mealehen venaasim kiglusekim megulgalim, kemo vetza megulgelet, shennitchammemu:

Hashsheluchin asurin. im nitrakkechu hazzetim kol kach ad shekkeshellokeach hazzayit beyado haggarin shebbetocho mishtalleach venofel meelav, asurin, demechamat hayyayin nitrakkechu. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Min hasselula. min hassal shellifne hachenvani: asurim. shemmezallef alehem yayin kede sheyyitrakkechu:
Min hahaftek. mimmakom shekkonsan sheotzrim otam sham ze al ze: muttarin. sheeno mezallef alehen yayin ad shennotnan lefanav limkor:

Vechen litruma. vechen kohen hechashud limkor teruma leshem chullin, kol hannimtza lefanav asur, shemma teruma hi. aval habba min haotzar, muttar, deirtote mirtat dilma shame rabbanan veyafkiru kol haotzar:
Ba lo lemizrach haazara. shello hayu machnisim hasseirim ben haulam velammizbeach kesherotze latet alehem goralot, ella baazara hayu ad sheat shechita:
Vekalpi. keli etz chalul:
Shel eshkeroa. 69 belaaz. min etz vechashuv hu:
Ben gamla. yehoshua ben gamla keshennitmanna lihyot kohen gadol asaan shel zahav:
Shello vetova. shello yaale sachar lakkemarim:
Haggabbaim shennichnesu labbayit. [yisreelim] shehen gabbain shel melech ligbot miyyad yisrael kesef gulgalta umissim vearnoniyyot, vehen amme haaretz, venichnesu leveto laavot avoto:
Habbayit tame. kol kele habbayit tame, lefi shemmechappesin bechol habbayit:

Im yesh immahen goy neemanim lomar lo nichnasnu. vechol shekken im en immahen nachri hen yoter veyoter neemanim lomar shello nichnasnu. ella mishshum sefa nakat la, dekatane aval en neemanim lomar nichnasnu velo naganu, dedavka im yesh immahem nachri en neemanim, demirtete min hannachri shemma yaanishem im lo yechappesu kol habbayit veal karchach hem memashmeshin kol asher babbayit. aval im en immahem nachri, neemanim af baze lomar nichnasnu aval lo naganu:
Im yesh immahen nachri o ishsha. sheggazru al hannachrim lihyot kazzavim lechol divrehem. vehaishsha, shemma hi nidda o zava:
Al rukko sorfim. sheal rukkim hannimtzaim sorfim et hatteruma, keditnan befirkin dilel, veaf al pi shehen safek, velo azlinan batar rubba:
Veal begadav holchim achar harov. im rov anshe otah hair zavim vezavot, sorfin:
Kelav temein midras. af al gav divyashav uva echad vedaras holchin achar harov, yashen shane, dechayshinan shemma rov bene adam darsu al begadav veechad mehen zav o zava:
Vachachamim metaharin. kevan dahave safek tuma birshut harabbim, tahor, shemma lo daras kelal:
Naga beechad ballayla. birshut harabbim davka mayre:
Vachachamim metammein. im raahu chay mibbaerev af al pi shebba shacharit umetzao shemmet, modim chachamim lerabbi meir shehu tahor, ucheshello raahu chay pelige. vahalacha kachachamim:
Happaron. dome levasilki, veyesh lo shene petachim mechuvvanim zo keneged zo:
Vechen hatztzedadin. mikkan umikkan lapparon, chashive nammi reshut harabbim, kevan sherabbim mishtammeshin beotan tzedadin:
Rabbi meir omer hatztzedadin reshut hayyachid. sheemtza happaron bilvad asuy lehishtammesh bo rabbim, velo hatztzedadin. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Sadin shel butz. kede sheyyakkir sheavodat hayyom bevigde butz, lefi shehu ragil leshammesh kol hashshana kullah bevigde zahav:
Venistappeg. venitkannach:

Vekiddesh yadav veraglav. min hakkiyyor. shetztzarich lechol chalifot bigde hayyom kiddush lifshita vekiddush lilvisha. utevila rishona zo, shehappeshita shel bigde chol hi, lo hutzrach kiddush yadayim veraglayim al happeshita:
Keratzo. shechato berov shene simanin, hechsher shechita bilvad:
Umerak acher. vegamar kohen acher bashshechita, lefi sheen kabbalat haddam keshera ella bechohen gadol vetzarich lemaher ulekabbel:
Al yado. bishvilo. i nammi al yado, acharav vesamuch lo, kemo veal yado hechzik, besefer ezra (perek 3):
Mi shehaya tahor. kohen shehaya tahor leechol batteruma, vehissiach dato milleechol od batteruma:
Shedderech temeim porshim mimmennu. hattemeim sheyyodim bo shehu tahor, porshim mimmennu, hilkach lo chayshinan shemma naga beadam tame vetimmeahu:
Vachachamim metammein. meachar shehissiach dato. vahalacha kachachamim:
Hayu yadav tehorot. beha mode rabbi yehuda daafillu amar yodea ani shello nitmeu yaday:
Yadav temeot. ufoslin et hatteruma, meachar shehissiach dato milleechol, lefi shehayyadayim askaniyyot hen venaga velav addateh:
Hare ellu muttarin. dechi havu shelemim safek avadum safek lo avadum, vaafillu im timtze lomar avadum, shemma vittelum ulechach shevarum, vehave sefek sefeka ulekulla:
Shekkayyotze vahem neevad. tavnit yad levaddah hen osim meikkara veovdin otah:
Lo ratzu lelammed al maase lechem happanim. shello hayu yodim shear ummanin lirdotam min hattannur shello yehe nishbar, mippene shehaya asuy kemin teva perutza:

Lo ratzu lelammed al maase hakketoret. makkirin hayu beesev echad sheshshemo maale ashan, ucheshehayu mearvim oto im sammene hakketoret haya ashan hakketoret mittammer veole kemin makkel velo haya pone elach vaelach:
Perek bashshir. hacheraat kol neima:
Al maase hakketav. kosher arbaa kulemosim bearba etzbeotav, vechotev shem ben arba otiyyot keachat:
Al harishonim. ben gamla uven katin, munbaz vehilni immo, venikanor:

Veal haacharonim. bet garmu uvet avtinas, hugras ben levi uven kamtzar. veaf al gav devet garmu uvet avtinas natnu taam ledivrehem shello ratzu lelammed, shemma yilmad adam sheeno hagun veyelech veyaavod laavoda zara bechach, lo kibbelu chachamim et divrehem:
Shota achat bair. vedavka ishsha shota, aval adam shote lo, deishsha regila beniddut, veen adam ragil bezivot:

O nachrit. vehu haddin lenachri, demiddeorayta en chilluk ben nachri lenachrit, vechullan tehorin, verabbanan gazru alayhu sheyyihyu kezavim. vechen kutit en chilluk ben kuti lechutit leman deamar kutim gere arayot hen, vegam haidna gazru alayhu sheyyihyu kenachrim lechol divrehem:
Kol harukkin shebbair temeim. sheddarkan lahaloch bechol hair:
O sheyyashva immo bisfina. dimtammea midras af al pi sheen begadeha nogim, keditnan beresh perek 3‏ dezavim:
Im makkirato shehu ochel batteruma kelav tehorim. deim hayta nidda o zava lo hayta doreset al begadav velo nichneset immo bisfina:
Gargeraniyyot. zollot umitauot lemaachol. targum ki hayiti zolela (Eicha 1), are haveti gargeranit. vahalacha kachachamim:
Avoda zara shel nachri asura miyyad. dichtiv (Devarim 7) pesile elohehem, mishsheppislo naasa lo leeloah:

Veshel yisrael ad shetteaved. dichtiv (sham 26) vesam bassater, ad sheyyaase lah devarim shel seter, kelomar sheyyaavdenna, shehayyisrael eno oved avoda zara ella vasseter mippene shemmityare mibbet din:
Nachri mevattel avoda zara shello. dichtiv pesile elohehem tisrefun baesh, keshehen nohagin bahen minhag elahut, aval im bitteluha hare ellu muttarim:
Veshel yisrael. bizman sheyyesh lo vah shuttafut. veen ken halacha, denachri en mevattel avoda zara shel yisrael afillu yesh lo vah shuttafut:
Veyisrael eno mevattel avoda zara shel nachri. vaafillu natan lo hannachri reshut:
Ureshut harabbim lattuma. devimot hachamma shechiche eynashe deazle bah liktzor veladush velacharosh hakkarka, lezarah lashshana habbaa:
Bimot haggeshamim. shehi zerua, en adam nichnas lah:

Yashen umetzao er habbayit tame. kol ma shebbabbayit tame, dechayshinan shemma keshehekitz mishshenato naga bakkelim shebbabbayit shello raa otam mittechilla keshehaya yashen, shekken derech bene adam lemashmesh velivdok beme shello rau meolam. aval er umetzao er, lo chayshinan, shekkevar raa kol asher babbayit keshehaya er:

Ad mekom shehu yachol lifshot et yado. kol hakkelim sheyyachol lehaggia lahem kesheyyoshit yado min hammakom shehaya yashen sham, chayshinan lehu shemma naga bahem, aval lo chayshinan shemma halach babbayit venaga bakkelim. vahalacha kachachamim:
Levet happarva. mechashshef echad sheshshemo parva benaah venikret al shemo:
Uvakkodesh hayta. shettevila sheniyya zo im kol shear tevilot, chutz min harishona, teunot makom kadosh, kedichtiv (Vayikra 16) verachatz et besaro vammayim bemakom kadosh:
Rabbi meir omer. pashat techilla veachar kach mekaddesh. veen halacha kerabbi meir:

Bigde lavan. ketonet, umichnasayim, veavnet, umitznefet haamurim befarashat achare mot, shekkol avodot penimiyyot hayu bahen. vaavodot chitzonot kegon temidin umusafin hayu bevigde zahav shehu meshammesh bahen kol hashshana kullah. uven kol chalifa vachalifa taun tevila ushete kiddushe yadayim veraglayim min hakkiyyor:
Rabbi meir metamme. sheim heviuhu shenayim lide mita chamura, lo yeviuhu lide hakkal:
Vachachamim omrim adam neeman al pi atzmo. dimtartzinan dibbureh, may lo nitmeti dekaamar, lo amadti betumati ella tavalti, vehoil vechen, adam neeman al yede atzmo:
Birshut hayyachid tame birshut harabbim tahor. dachashiv kishar sefek tuma dealma:
Ad sheyyomar lo nagati. lav davka sheyyomar bari li shello nagati, dehu haddin hecha deikka midi lemitle beh shello naga:
Shevile vet gilgul. makom agol veole veyored, veen rov am yecholin lalechet beotan shevilin:

Reshut hayyachid lashshabbat. lav reshut hayyachid mammash, ella karmelit ninhu. veammay kare la reshut hayyachid, lefi sheenah reshut harabbim. vechen ha ditnan besamuch, habbika bimot hachamma reshut hayyachid leshabbat, lav reshut hayyachid mammash, ella karmelit. vehasheta kol hane gavne ditnan hacha dahavu reshut harabbim, mayre kegon delekka telata beshaa shennolad hassafek, vaafillu hachi kevan derabbim metzuyin sham, kirshut harabbim dame. dei bidikka telata behahi shata shennolad hassafek bah, afillu bechadre chadarim tahor, deyalfinan missota dahave reshut hayyachid, mishshum delekka tamman ella tere, boel venivelet:
Eshet chaver. shenneemenet al hattohorot, deeshet chaver hare hi kechaver:
Shehinnicha leeshet am haaretz. sheenah neemenet, deeshet am haaretz uvanav kemoto, ad sheyyekabbelu alehem divre chaverut:
Paska harechayim. gamra techinatah ufaska millitchon. dechol zeman shehi asuka bimlachtah barechayim enah holechet umemashmeshet babbayit:
Vachachamim omrim vechulei. vahalacha kachachamim:
Lashon shel zehorit. tzemer tzavua adom:
Keneged bet shillucho. keneged shaar sheyyotziuhu bo:

Velannishchat. haya kosher lashon shel zehorit keneged bet shechitato, kelomar betzavvaro, vehasheta lo ate leitchallufe bisir hammishtalleach, shezze berosho veze betzavvaro. vetarvayyhu bishar seirim lo mitchallefe, sheellu lashon shel zehorit keshura bahem useirim acherim en lashon shel zehorit keshura bahem:

Aviti pashati chatati. matnitin rabbi meir hi, deyalef mikkera dichtiv (Vayikra 16) vehitvadda alav et kol avonot bene yisrael veet kol pishehem lechol chattotam. aval chachamim pelige aleh veamre avonot ellu zedonot, peshaim ellu meradim, chattaot ellu shegagot, leachar shehitvadda al hazzedonot veal hammeradim chozer umitvadde al hashshegagot bitmiyya, ella amar chatati aviti pashati. vechen bedavid hu omer (tehillim kav) chatanu im avotenu heevinu vehirshanu. vahalacha kachachamim. umahu ze sheamar moshe (Shemot 34) nose avon vafesha vechattaa. kach amar moshe lifne hammakom, beshaa sheyyisrael chotim veosim teshuva, ase lahem zedonot kishgagot:
Tamid karev. mishsheat holachat evarim vaelach kachashev:
Atzmo. bechol yom tisha. shishsha laevarim velakkeravayim, kidamrinan leel, veechad lassolet. veechad lachavittin veechad layyayin:
Uvechag. shetztzarich shene nesachin, echad shel yayin veechad shel mayim, beyad kohen echad tzelochit shel mayim:

Shel ben haarbayim. shebbechol yom shenayim beyadam shene gezire etzim lehosif al atze maaracha, dichtiv (Vayikra 1) vearchu etzim al haesh, im eno inyan letamid shel shachar, shekkevar neemar uvier aleha hakkohen etzim, tenehu inyan letamid shel ben haarbayim, shemmosifim shene gezire etzim:
Af anu machazikin yedehem shel ellu. haovdim lachamma velallevana. im hayinu roin sheshshear avoda zara charvu meatzman veellu kayyamot, hayinu modim leellu:
Tormin et hammizbeach. terumat haddeshen, shehu chote min haddeshen bemachta ben rav ben meat, venotno bemizracho shel kevesh venivla sham bimkomo, vehi hayta techillat haavoda beshacharit:
O samuch lo. samuch likriat haggever, o millefaneha o milleachareha:
Beyom hakkippurim torem mechatzot. mishshum chulsha dechohen gadol, shealav levaddo muttal hakkol, tzarich lehashekim yoter:

Uvargalim. dinfishe yisrael unefishe karbanot verav haddeshen bimkom hammaaracha, vetzarich lehaalot haddeshen min hammaaracha lammakom shebbeemtza hammizbeach sheshshemo tappuach, shellesham gal gadol shel deshen tzavur umechuvvenet ketappuach, hayu tzerichim lehashekim yoter, vehayu mashkimin min haashmoret harishona shehi shelish hallayla:
Velo hayta keriat haggever maggaat. bargalim:
Ad shehayta azara melea miyyisrael. hammeviim karbenotehem lehakerivam miyyad achar tamid shel shachar:

Sheppaam achat ala meor hallevana. lav beyom hakkippurim kaamar, dei efshar laalot meor hallevana samuch lashshachar beyom hakkippurim, shehu bishlish hachodesh, ella besof echad min hechodashim keshehallevana ola samuch laalot hashshachar era ze hattaut, vechashshu shemma beyom hakkippurim yeera taut acher kayyotze bo, lechach hutzrechu lechol ze:

Horidu chohen gadol. milleta beanpe nafsha hi. vehasheta mehadder leha ditninan leel ad chevron vehu omer hen. uleachar sheheshiv haroe hen, hayu moridin kohen gadol levet hattevila, shehaya taun tevila kodem sheyyishchat hattamid:
Hammesech raglav. kinnuy linkavim gedolim:
Bika. sadot shel anashim harebe, uvimot haggeshamim shehen charushot uzeruot yesh lahen din reshut hayyachid, lefi shebbene adam nizharim millehallech al gabbe hazzeraim shello yafsidu:
Rabbi elazar metaher. dahave leh sefek bia, veen kol habbika chashuva kesade achat, lefi shehassadot chalukim bammetzarim shellahem:
Laavoda. lav davka:

Ad sheyyitbol. shehaddevarim kal vachomer, uma kohen gadol hammeshanne mikkodesh lekodesh, meavodat chutz laavodat penim umeavodat penim laavodat chutz, taun tevila ben avoda laavoda, ze habba mibbeto shehu mechol lekodesh lo kol shekken shettaun tevila:
Al bet happarva. al lishkat bet happarva:
Chutz mizzo. harishona, shehayta bachol al gabbe shaar hammayim, uvetzad lishkato hayta:
Im haya chacham doresh. bidvar halacha kol lel yom hakkippurim, shello yishan veyire keri. veim talmid hu velo chacham, sheyyodea lehavin velishmoa devar halacha veeno yodea lidrosh, dorshim lefanav:
Beiyyov uveezra. shehen devarim hammoshchim et hallev lashshoman, veen shena chotafto:
Rabbi yishmael. zo vetzad zo. vechol shekken achat al gabbe shetayim, shezzo ikkar markulis. [markulis shem avoda zara hannikra vilshonam meorkuris]:

Betzad markulis. betzad arba ammot shel markulis, kelomar shehaavanim rechokot arba ammot min hammarkulis veyadua delav minneh nafal, uveha kaamar rabbi yishmael deshalosh avanim asurot, sheen markulis pachot mishshalosh avanim, veosin markulis katan betzad markulis gadol. vekatan hannaase betzad gadol avde leh bechol dehu veen choshshin sheyyihye achat al gabbe shetayim. verabbanan savre, en osin markulis katan betzad markulis gadol, hilkach nirot immo, kelomar semuchot lo, deikka lememar deminneh nafal, ben shetayim ben shalosh asurim. en nirot immo, muttarot. vahalacha kachachamim:
Gat beuta. shebbeatah uderachah nachri:

Af al pi shehu notel beyado. anavim mittoch hayyayin: venoten lattappuach. mekom asifat haanavim heasuy kemin gal karuy tappuach, vesavar tanna didan deeno naase yen nesech ad sheyyered labbor. vezo mishna rishona hi, veen halacha, ella chevan shehitchil hayyayin lehimmashech, naase yen nesech:
Ma shebbabbor asur. im yigga bo nachri achare chen:
Mi shochet. et hattamid:

Mi zorek vechulei. kol haavodot hallalu befayis echad hen. shemmi sheyyichle bo hacheshbon kemo shepperashnu, zacha, vehu zorek et haddam lammizbeach achar shekkibbel haddam bammizrak, shehazzorek hu hamekabbel. vehassamuch lo shochet. veaf al pi shehashshechita kodemet lekabbalat haddam, mikkol makom mippene sheavodat hazzerika gedola min hashshechita, shehashshechita keshera bezar ma sheen ken bazzerika, demikkabbala vaelach mitzvat kehunna, lefichach zacha harishon shehiggia lo happayis bazzerika, vehassamuch lo bashshechita. vehassamuch lashshochet medashshen et hammizbeach, vehassamuch lamdashshen et hammizbeach medashshen et hammenora. vechen kullam:
Harosh veharegel. shel yamin, bechohen echad:
Ushete hayyadayim. bechohen sheni:
Haoketz. hu hazzanav
Veharegel. shel semol, bechohen shelishi:
Hechaze. hu shumman hechaze haroe et hakkarka, vechotchin oto elach vaelach belo rashe hatztzelaot:
Vehaggera. makom shehu maale gera, hu hatztzavvar, uvo mechubbarim kene harea im hakkaved vehallev. hechaze vehaggera bechohen revii.
Ushete haddefanot. bechohen chamishshi.
Vehakkeravayim. bashshishshi.
Vehassolet. issaron leminchat nisko shel tamid bashshevii.
Vehachavittim. chatzi issaron leminchato shel kohen gadol shekkereva im hattemidim bechol yom, shenneemar (Vayikra 6) machatzitah babboker umachatzitah baarev, bashshemini.
Vehayyayin. shelosha luggin lenesech hattamid, batteshii:
Shelosha asar kohanim zochin bo. befayis ze, shelosh esre avodot shel kohanim hammenuyot bahen kefi hasseder hakkatuv bammishna:
Kederech hillucho. bechayyav:

Haya karev. hattamid. tanna kamma savar hattov vehayyafe karev techilla, uven azay savar kederech hillucho, harosh veharegel, hechaze vehaggera, ushete hayyadayim, ushete haddefanot, haoketz veharegel. veen halacha keven azay:

Lo yeshev betzillah. hay tzel lav tachat nof haashera kaamar, delo have matze lemitne tu veim yashav tahor, deha katane sefa deim avar tame. ella min hailan vahala, dichshehachamma vammizrach o vammaarav yesh lechol davar tzel aroch:
Lo yaavor tachteha. tachat hannof mehailan, shehailan maahil alav. veim avar tame:
Hayta gozelet et harabbim. shennofah note lirshut harabbim:
Tahor. detuma derabbanan hi vehecha degozelet harabbim lo gazru rabbanan:
Yerakot bimot haggeshamim. shehailan kashe lahem shemmonea hachamma millavo:
Aval lo vimot hachamma. shehatztzel yafe lahem:
Vehachazarin. chazeret. uvaaravi chasa:
Lo vimot hachamma velo vimot haggeshamim. shehatztzel yafe lahem leolam:

Shehannemiyya. alin hannoshrin min hailan bimot haggeshamim. uvaggemara farech, deha shaminan leh lerabbi yose deamar ze vaze gorem muttar, leel befirkin gabbe mefarer vezore laruach veaf al pi shennaase zevel, dehecha shehahetter vehaissur shenehem gormin lehavi haddavar, kegon shehakkarka shel hetter vehazzevel shel avoda zara shel issur gormin litzmichat hayyerakot, sevira leh lerabbi yose shehu muttar, vehechi kaasar hayyerakot hacha mippene shehannemiyya nosheret alehen. umeshane, sherabbi yose hacha ledivrehen shel rabbanan kaamar, ledidchu deamritu ze vaze gorem asur, haya lachem leesor hayyerakot mippene shehannemiyya nosheret alehen vehi hova lahem lezevel. verabbanan savre, shane hacha sheen hailan shel avoda zara moil layrakot kelum, shemma shemmashbiach lahem bannemiyya, pogem lahem batztzel. vahalacha kerabbi yose deze vaze gorem muttar:

Hammanniach ummanim vechulei. mishshum deummanin samchu datayhu lemashmesh kol asher babbayit, vesalka datach amena divha modu chachamim lerabbi meir dechol habbayit tame, ka mashma lan daafillu beummanin pelige rabbanan aleh veamre deen tame ella ad mekom shehen yecholin lifshot et yadam veligga. vahalacha kachachamim:

Ben dam laevarim. lav davka, deha tenan leel vekibbel et haddam uzerako nichnas lehaketir ketoret ulehetiv et hannerot ulehakriv et harosh veet haevarim, alma hayta ketoret kereva ben dam lannerot velo ben dam laevarim. ella lo ba hattanna achshav lomar seder hahakravot zo achar zo ech hayu, aval ratza lomar bilvad shello hayta zerikat haddam vehakeravat haevarim retzufim zo achar zo, shehare hakketoret hayta mafseket benehen, vehu haddin nammi shehatavat hannerot hayta benehen leachar hakketoret kodem hakeravat haevarim:
Istenis. sheggufo metzunnan vekar:
Mechammin lo chammin. beerev yom hakkippurim:
Umetilin. beyom hakkippurim letoch chakak binyan bet tevilato:
Shettafug. lehasir tzinnatan bemiktzat. kemo mefigin taaman [betza daf yad]:
Barishona kol mi sherotze litrom. kol kohen shehu meoto bet av verotze litrom et haddeshen shacharit, torem, velo haya payis baddavar:
Uvizman shehem merubbim. habbaim litrom, ze omer ani torem veze omer ani torem, ze haya mishpatam:
Ratzim veolim bakkevesh. hammizbeach, shehu sheloshim ushetayim amma orech:
Vechol hakkodem. likkanes letoch arba ammot elyonot shel kevesh hassemuchot lerosh hammizbeach, zacha litrom. vezehu goralam:

Veim hayu shenehem shavim. bichnisatam, en echad mehem zoche litrom, aval meatta kullam bain lehatil goral. umahu haggoral, hammemunne al happeyasot omer lechullam hatzebiu, kelomar hotziu etzbeotechem kol echad yare etzbao, mippene sheasur limnot anashim miyyisrael lefichach hutzrechu lehotzi haetzbaot kede sheyyimnu haetzbaot velo haanashim. vechetzad osim, makkifim veomdim beiggula, vehamemunne ba venotel mitznefet merosho shel echad mehem umimmennu happayis matchil limnot, umotzi kol echad etzbao, vehammemunne motzi mippiv sach uminyan, o mea, o shishshim, harebe yoter mimma sheyyesh sham kohanim, veomer mi sheyyichle cheshbon ze etzlo yizke. umatchil limnot mizze shennatal merosho hammitznefet, vesovev veholech umone haetzbaot vechozer chalila ad sof hamminyan, umi shehamminyan kale bo hu hazzoche. vechen kol happeyasot shebbammikdash:
Echad o shenayim. etzba echad im hu bari o shenayim im hu chole. shehachole eno yachol lichbosh etzbeotav, ucheshemmotzi achat yotza chavertah immah, veen hashshenayim nimnin ella achat:

Veen motziim aguddal bammikdash. mippene harammaim, kesheyyikrav hamminyan lichlot veyavinu lemi yichle, yotzi ze haomed lefanav shete etzbaot kede sheyyimmane lishne vene adam vimaher hamminyan lichlot bo, vehammemunne lo yavin lefi shehaadam yachol leharechik haagudal min haetzba harebe ad shennire keetzbeot shene bene adam, ma sheen yachol laasot ken bishar etzbaot:

Happat vehashshemen vechulei. kol hane, asurin mishshum chatnut. ufat shel nachtomin hittiruhu, aval pat shel baale vattim lo huttar ella leholche derachim uvishat haddechak. vehashshemen rau shello fashat issuro venimnu alav vehittiruhu, kidmassik bematnitin:

Ushelakot. kol davar shebbishshelu oto hannachrim, vaafillu vishshelu oto bechelav shel yisrael uvefanav, sheen lachush letaarovet issur ulegiule nachrim, asaruhu mishshum bishshule nachrim. vehu shello siyyea bo yisrael lo vattechilla velo vassof. velo asru mishshum bishshule nachrim ella davar sheeno neechol kemo shehu chay veole al shulchan melachim lelappet bo et happat. aval im chaser achat meellu, en bo mishshum bishshule nachrim:
Uchevashin sheddarkan latet bahen yayin. veen issuran issur hanaa, lefi sheen taam hayyayin nikkar bahen. aval baachila asurin:
Tarit terufa. min dagim tehorim shettorfin otan dak dak veenan nikkarin. vaasurin keshennilkechu min hannachrim, shemma [nichtash] immahem dag tame:
Vetzir sheen bah daga. dag katan shennikra chilbit. vedarko shehu gadel betoch [tzir shel] dagim tehorim, uchesheyyesh tzir dag tame meorav immo lo yigdal bo chilbit:

Vehachillak. min dagim ketannim tehorim, veen lahem senappir vekaskeset, veatid ligdol achar zeman. vedagim ketannim temeim haddomim lahem mitarvim immahem veenam nikkarim afillu kesheenah terufa. aval tarit en haddagim temeim domim lah, ulechach share kesheenah terufa:
Chiltit. kach shemah baaravi. vechotchin keratav besakkin. vaasura mishshum shamnunit desakkin, deaggav charifuta [dechiltit] mamteket hi taam hashshamnunit hannivla bah:
Umelach salkontit. melach shekkol gedole romi ochlin otah, uregilin limshoach otah bechelev chazir uveshumman dagim temeim, vehi gassa ulevana veyoter:
Samuch levet avoda zara. shehaya echad mikketalav bet avoda zara, vehabbayit atzmo neevad:
Asur livnoto. shebbone vayit laavoda zara:
Kones letoch karka shello arba ammot. veeno mannicho fanuy, shennimtza mehanne laavoda zara shemmarchiv et gevulah, ella memalle hammakom kotzim veose sham bet hakkisse letinokot:
Haya shello veshel avoda zara. shemmekom ovi hakkotel chetzyo shello:
Niddon mechetza al mechetza. oto chelek shel avoda zara eno ole bichnisat arba ammot, aval chelko ole, sheim avyo shete ammot mone amma shello vechones shalosh ammot betoch shello:
Avanav veetzav vaafaro. shel oto kotel:
Metammein kashsheretz. vaafillu chelko shel yisrael, lefi sheen berera:
Kashsheretz. shemmetamme vemagga veeno metamme vemassa. lefi shettumat avoda zara derabbanan, akilu vah. veenah metammea vechaadasha chashsheretz, ella vechazzayit kammet:
Rabbi akiva omer kannidda. veen halacha kerabbi akiva afillu vaavoda zara atzmah, vechol shekken bimshammesheha:
Mippene ma asru gevinot shel nachrim. baachila. ulerabbanan ka vae. umishshum chalav shel behema temea lekka lemechash, dekim lan dachalev behema temea eno nikpe:
Sorfah chayya. defirsha vealma hi:
Bekevat egle avoda zara. veaf al gav defirsha vealma hi, asur, deshane avoda zara dichtiv bah (Devarim 13) velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem:

Hissio ledavar acher. velo ratza lehaggid lo tamo shel davar, mippene sheadayin lo avru shenem asar chodesh shennigzera gezera zo, vechi gazre rabbanan gezera lo megallu letaama ad teresar yarche shatta ad shettitpashshet gezeratan, dilma ikka dela sevira leh letaama veate lezalzole veh. vetaama deasru gevinot shel nachrim, mippene shemmaamidin otah beor keva shel shechitat nachrim shehi nevela. veaf al pi shehu davar muat keneged kol hechalav, kevan shehu maamid hechalav veose vo maase, lo vatel, dekayma lan hakkol holech achar hammaamid. umishshum basar bechalav lo haya asur, kevan shehabbasar bifne atzmo muttar eno oser bechalav af al pi shemmaamido, ad sheyyitten bo taam. aval davar shel issur meikkaro, oser behetter af al pi sheeno noten bo taam, kol zeman shehu maamid:
Ki tovim dodayich miyyayin. hakkadosh baruch hu omer ken lichneset yisrael:
En haddavar ken. ella cheneset yisrael amra lifne hakkadosh baruch hu, arevim alay divre dodecha, kelomar takkanot shettikkenu vegazru hachachamim, yoter miyyenah shel tora, meikkar tora shebbichtav:

Shehaya mittechillato yayin. laafoke hecha dekana hannachri chometz miyyisrael, delo mittesar bahanaa. detaama demittesar bahanaa, mishshum dilma nassecheh laavoda zara, vechometz lo ka minnassach laavoda zara:

Vecheres haderiyyani. adriyyanus kesar haya megabbel tit beyayin veose mimmennu chelim velo haya metzarfan bechivshan, venosim otan bammilchama, uchesherotzim lishtot mesimim otam hacharasim bemayim venimmochim sham, vehattit shokea lematta, venishar hayyayin mazug bammayim. veal shem adriyyanus nikra cheres haderiyyani:
Orot levuvin. korim habbehema mechayyim keneged hallev kemin nekev agol umotziin hallev umakrivin oto laavoda zara:
Mashuch muttar. sheen osin laavoda zara ella agol. vahalacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Hayyotze asur bahanaa. shekkevar naasa tikrovet:
Lattarput. litot avoda zara [lemerachok. Rashi]. mekom ervatah shel ishsha nikra vet turpa:
Asur laset velatet immahem. deazlu umodu laavoda zara. veod, dezavne mide ditzrich letikrovet avoda zara. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Haddar im am haaretz. mukkafot tzamid patil. temeot, mishshum ishto nidda, shemma hissita veyashva vetimmea et hakkol:

Rabbi yehuda metaher betannur. mishshum dei efshar lehassito, distamo mechubbar ketzat, sheosin lo tefela lechabbero baaretz. uman dimtamme savar gazrinan mechubbar attu sheeno mechubbar. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
